text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ia, e tikina bibi oqo, me wali ka taura e vuqa na yabaki bera ni da raica na taraicake ni cokoti vata me buli.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Na icula sitila ena vude ena dela ni wai baleta ni kaukauwa e tiko e delana.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: E yaco na kaukauwa e tiko e delana baleta na wai e tiko e dela ni wai e dreta kaukauwa mai ni vakatauvatani ena cagi ka tiko e delana.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Na wai e vakayacora me vaka e dua na kulina ka sega ni laurai ena dela ni wai me vaka na veika e vakatarai me vude e dela ni wai.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Na batini dua na ivava ni vakasisi ena ucacevata e rua na babana ka lobi mai e yasana ruarua. E vakatara na batina ruarua me rawarawa na kena qumea na ucacevata, ena gauna talega e vakatajiki kina.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Baleta ni lobi cake mai na botona, ni sa vakatajiki ki dua na yasana na yameni vava, na yasana ka tara tiko na ucaceva ena lobi talega.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: E vakavuna me vuki o koya ka dauvakasisi. Kevaka e vakatajiki ki na imatau, ena vuki ki yasana imatau o koya ka vakasisi tiko, kevaka e vakatajiki kina imawi, ena vuki ki yasana imawi o koya ka vakasisi tiko.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Me lesuvi tale na ivakatagedegede ni kaukauwa sa oti, sa dodonu me ra na biuta tani na kaukauwa tale eso era rawati mai na rarama.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Era vakayacora oqo ni ra biuta mai e dua na tikina lailai mai na rarama ka vakatokai me "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Era vakatoka na iwalewale na kena daunivakadidike me "stimulated emission of radiation" baleta ni ra yavalati na bula somidi lalai (atoms) oqo mai na rarama, ka vakavuna me ra ramase mai e vuqa na rarama, ka sa dua na mataqali kaukauwa na rarama.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Na itaba ka tarava e vakaraitaka na kena sa biuta tani tiko mai na bula somidi lalai na photons. E dina sara, ni photons era somidi lalai sara mai na kena e vakaraitaki ena itaba.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Na photons era somidi lalai sara mai na veika e bulia na bula somidi lalai (atoms)!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ni oti e vica na drau na auwa ni kena sagai tiko e mai kama e dua na tikina ena matanicina ka mai vakavuna na kena sega ni cakacaka.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Sa gadrevi me sosomitaki na matanicina. Sa gadrevi sara me qarauni na kena sosomitaki.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Sa dodonu me na boko vaka eliu na itabataba ni waqa ni cina se cavu saraga na wa ni livaliva.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Oqo sa baleta na dewa ni livaliva ena wa ki na tikina kaukamea e dabe toka kina na matanicina ena rawa ni vakavuna me kati iko na livaliva kevaka o tatara e loma se na kena idabedabe kaukamea kevaka madaga se vakatikina tiko.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Na gacagaca bibi ni kena cicivaki na sala ni dra sai koya na uto, ni sa pamuta na dra.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: E lako tani mai na uto na dra ena sala ni dra ka vakatokai me ualevu (arteries) ka qai suka tale kina uto ena ualalai (veins) ka vakatokai me ua. Na sala lalai sa vakatokai me capillaries.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Na bati ni triceratops e sega walega ni qaqia na draunikau, e qaqia talega na tabanikau kei na waka ni kau kaukauwa.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Eso na vakadidike era nanuma ni kakana ni Triceratops na cycads, e dua na mataqali vunikau a tubu vakalevu ena drau na milioni sa oti.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: O ira na vunikau qo era rairai tu vaka na vuni niu lailai vakaisalataki ena dua na draunikau gata ka votovotoa.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Na Triceratops erawa ni vakayagataka gusuna kaukauwa balavu me drutia na drauna ni bera ni kania na gau-ni-kau.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Eso tale na vakadidike e veibataka ni o ira na vunikau aqo era paisoni ka sega ni rawa me ra kania na dainaso, sega ni vaka na sloth kei so tale na manumanu vaka na koki ( era kawa ni dainaso) erawa ni ra kania na draunikau se vuanikau paisoni.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: E na dreti iko vakacava na idre ni qele? Kevaka mo tucake ena qeteqete kei lo, na kemu bibi ena lailai cake mai na kemu bibi e vuravura.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: E dua na tamata e 200 na paudi (90 na kilo) e Vuravura ena lei 36 na paudi (16 na kilo) e na lo. Koya ena mamada kina na idre oya e maliwa lala.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: E sega ni vaka bukuna na Matanisiga me vakai Vuravura koya vakatara me da tucake kina. Na Matanisiga taucoko e buli mai ena cagi, na kama, kei na palasama.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Na cagi ena lei mamare mai ni o toso volekata tiko yani na Matanisiga.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Na tutuna eda raica tiko yani ena Matanisiga e vakatokai na fotosifia, kena ibalebale na "polo ni rarama".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Rauta ni oti e tolu na udolu na yabaki, ena 1610, e dua na Turaga ni Itali dau vakadidike e maliwalala, o Galileo Galilei a vakayagata e dua na vakadodorairai ka dikeva kina ni vaka iwase ni vuki o Venus, me vaka ga na vula.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Na iwase e dau yaco baleta na yasana ga vei Venus (se ena Vula) koya e qara ena siga e rarama. Na iwase nei Venus e tokona na nona vakavuvuli o Copernicus oya ni o ira na vei vuravura eso e wavokita na Matanisiga.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ni oti e vica na yabaki ena 1639, qai dikeva e dua na dauvakadidike ena vula o Jeremiah Horroks na veisau e yaco e Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: O Igiladi a lako curuma e vuqa na yabaki ni tiko marau ni oti na kena mai va rawai o ira na Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ia ena yabaki 991 o Ethelred a sota kaya e dua na matanivalu ni Viking ka lewe vuqa mai vei ira kecekece me vaka na gauna nei Guthrum ena vica na drau na yabaki sa oti.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Na mataivalu qo a veiliutaki kina o Olaf Trygvasson, a kai Norway ka tudei ena sasaga me taura lesu nona vanua mai vei ira na kai Denmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ni mai oti taumada na veileti ni mataivalu, Sa qai mai ciqomi ka yalayala o Ethelred vata kei Olaf, o koya ka sa qai lesu i Norway me lai liutaka na nona matanitu ena vuku ni vei mataqali qaqa.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Na Hangeul e matanivola tauyavutaki vaka inaki me vakayagataki vakawasoma e veisiga. A tauyavutaki ena 1444 ena gauna ni nona vakatulewa na Tui o Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Na Tui o Sejong e ka va ni Tui ena matanitu o Joseon ka dua vei ira e dokai sara vakalevu.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A vakayacana taumada na matanivola ni Hangeul na Hunmin Jeongeum, kena ibalebalena "na irogorogo donu ni vakavuvuli vei ira na tamata ".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: E levu na ivakamacala ena kena yaco mai na Sanskrit. E dua vei ira e baleta tiko na nodra toki ki na ra kei India na Aryan koya era kauta mai kina na nodra vosa.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Na Sanskrit e dua na vosa ni gauna makawa ka vakatautauvatataki kei na vosa vaka Latin e vosataki e Iurope.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Na ivola e kilai taumada ena ivalu a volai vaka Sanskrit. Ni oti na kumuni vata na Upanishads, a qai seyavu na sanskrit ena vuku ni nodra lewena na veta e ra
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: E dua na vosa dredre ka vutuniyau na Sanskrit, e vurevure ni vuqa tale na vosa vaka Idia ena gauna oqo, me vakataka na Latin e vurevure ni vosa e vanua o Iurope me vakataka na vosa vaka Varanise kei na Sipeni.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ni sa oti na ivalu e Varanise, o Jamani qai tekivu vakavakarau me ravuta na yanuyanu vaka Peretania.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Era qai vakatoka na Jamani na veivaluti ena vosa sega ni kilai me “Operation Sealion”. Vuqa na gasau bibi ni valu kei na ivurevure ni Sotia a yali ena gauna era biuti Dunkirk kina, era gogo sara kina na sotia.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: E kaukauwa cake na Mataivalu e wai ni Ranadi mai vei ira Mataivalu e wai ni Jamani (“Kriegsmarine”) ka rawa me ra ravuta na waqa lelevu era takosova na iyalayala kei Igiladi.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ia, e vica ga na waqa ni Mataivalu e wai era vakatawana na gaunisala e ravuti rawarawa ka era kidrova na Admiral ni ra na vakaluvuci mai na veiravuti nei Jamani.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Meda tekivu mada ena dua na ivakamacala me baleta na nodratou ituvatuva mai Italy. O Italy e "tacina gone"tiko o Jamani kei Japani.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: A gogo na nodratou mataivalu sotia kei na mataivalu e wai, dina ga ni seqai tara e va na waqa ni bera ni tekivu na ivalu.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Na nodratou inaki mai Itali o iratou na matanitu e Aferika. Me rawa ni ratou rawai ira na matanitu oqo, e gadrevi na waqa lalai, me ra takoso kina na mataivalu ki na wasawasa o Mediterranean ka ravuti Aferika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Me yaco vaka kina, e vinakati me ratou vakasava laivi na nodratou yavu na Peretania kei na nodra waqa na Ijipita. Kevaka e sega ni ratou cakava oya, ena sega ni ratou na cakava rawa e dua tale na ka.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ia vei Japani. O Japani e dua na matanitu e wai vakataki Peretania.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Na manua era waqa buli me ra lako e loma ni wai, ka tu kina ena dua na gauna balavu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Na manua era a vakayagataki ena iMatai ni Valu levu kei na iKarua ni Valu Levu. Ena gauna oya era se berabera ka lekaleka talega na vanua era vanalaka.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ena kena se tekivu na ivalu era lako e dela ni wai, ia ni sa buli na radar ka laurai na kena dodonu sa vakuwai vei ira na manua me ra lako e loma ni wai me ra kua kina ni laurai.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Na nodra manua na Jamani era vakatokai na U-Boats. O ira na Jamani era vakasakiti ena vakatasosoko kei na cicivaki ni nodra manua.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Na nodra rawa ka ni cicivaki na manua, ni oti na ivalu, era sa sega ni niutaki na Jamani mera taukena e levu.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Io, na Tui o Tutankhamun, a vakatokai ena so na gauna me o "Tui Tut" se na "Na Tui Tagane", e dua vei ira na tui makawa kilai levu e Ijipita ena gauna vou.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: E lasa, ni a sega ni nanumi me dua na tamata bibi ena gauna makawa ka sega ni vola itukutuku taki ena vuqa na lisi ni tui makawa.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ia, na kune ni nona bulubulu ena 1922 a qai kilai levu kina. Dina ni vuqa na ibulubulu ni gauna makawa era a butakoci, na nona ibulubulu a sega ni bau tarai.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: E vuqa na iyaya e buluti vata kei Tutankhamun e maroroi vinaka, oka kina e udolu na cakacaka ni liga ka caka mai na metali mareqeti kei na vatu kune dredre.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Na buli ni qiqi votovotoa e vakamamada na toalili ni Assyria, totolo cake, ka vukea me cici vakatotolo cake mai vei ira na sotia kei na so tale na toalili.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Na imoto mai na dakai titi dau veivakamatei e rawa ni curu basikata na iyaragi ni tataqomaki vei ira na meca. Rauta na 1000 B.K., era tekivuna na mataivalu ni Siria o ira na sotia vodo ose ena ivalu.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Na cavalry e dua na mataivalu e valu ena vodo ose. Na kena idabedabe e sebera ni se buli, okoya eratou vala kina na Assyrian cavalry ena daku ni ose wale saraga.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Eda kila e vuqa na politiki, vakadidike, kei na dau droini era kai Kirisi. E dua vei ira na kilai levu ni vanua oqo o Homer, e dua e kilai levu ena vola serekali, e vola e rua na tikina vakasakiti esa umani tu ena volaitalanoa kei Kirisi: o rau na serekali na Iliad kei Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Erau kilai levu ena voladrama o Sophocles kei Aristophanes kei na nodrau drama e kilai tani ni dua vei ira na cakacaka vakasakiti ena vuravura vaka volaitalanoa.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: E dua tale na kai Kirisi kilai levu ka daunifika o Pythagoras, a kilai tani ena nona vakavuvuli kilai-levu ni veiwakani ena tutuna erua ka gole vakadodonu mai na kona ki na rua na poidi ni dua na vatuka rivirivi.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: E duidui na vakatagedegede ni vosa vaka Idia. E nanumi ni na vosa oqo e tiko ena tadrua ni karua kei na ikava ni vosa e vosataki vakalevu e vuravura.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Na levu ni wiliwili era vosa vaka itaukei e vakatau kevaka e wilika na vei vosa veiwekani voleka.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Rauta toka e 340 na milioni ki na 500 era vosa, ka rawa ni yaco sara ena 800 na milioni na tamata erawa ni kila na vosa.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Na Hindi kei na Urdu e tautauvata ena vosa ia e duidui ena kena volai; o ira e vosataka ruarua na vosa oqo ena veisiga e rawa ni kila na veika e tukuni tiko.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Rauta na ika 15 ni senituri, na vualiku kei Estonia a vakavulici sara vakalevu ena itovo mai vei Jamani
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Eso na turaga ni Jamani era dau masumasu e ulunivanua (monk) era vinakata mera kauta vakavoleka mai na Kalou ki vei ira na itaukei, era qai tauyavutaka sara na vosa dina vaka Estonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: E yavu mai na matanivola ni Jamani kei na vakuri ni dua na kerekita "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Sa toso tiko na gauna, vuqa tale na vosa kerei mai vei ira na Jamani e qai mai cokovata. Oqo na itekitekivu ni veivakararamataki.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Na kena itovo, ena curu e liu ena mataivalu ni oti na nona vuli e dua e navuci ni na taura na itutu ni veiliutaki vakatui.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ia, o Charles a vuli ena univesiti e Trinity College, mai Cambridge ka vulica kina na Anthropology kei na Archaeology, ka qai vuli Tukutuku Makawa, rawata kina e 2:2 (e dua na ivolakoroi lailai).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: E isevu ni lewe o Charles ni Vuvale Vakatui me rawata na ivolakoroi.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: O Turkey e Iurope (vualiku kei Thrace se Rumelia ena toba ko Balkan) e okata e 3% ni vanua.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Na iyalayala nei Turkey e sivia e 1,600 kilomita (1,000 maile) na kena balavu ka 800 na km (500 maile) na kena raba, vatuka vaka na rectangle.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Na vanua o Turkey, e oka kina na drano, ka taura e 783,562 sikuwea na kilomita (300,948 sq mi), e 755,688 sikuwea na kilomita (291,773 sq mi) ena ceva e ra kei Esia kei 23,764 sikuwea na kilomita (9,174 sq mi) e Iurope.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Na kena levu o Turkey e cakava me ka 37 ni matanitu vanua levu e vuravura, ka vaka na kena levu kevaka me cokovata na siti lelevu kei Varanise kei United Kingdom.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: E wavoliti Turkey ena tolu na yasana na wasawasa: ena ra na wasawasa o Aegean, ena vualiku na wasawasa Loaloa, kei na wasawasa na Mediterranean ki na ceva.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: O Luxembourg e tiko na kena italanoa makawa ka balavu ia na nodra tugalala e tekivu mai na 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Na gauna oqo o Belgium a tiki ni vanua Luxembourg ena gauna e liu ia a qai vakayacani me o Belgian ni oti na Beivaluvaluti nei Belgian ena 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: O Luxembourg e vanua dau saga tu ga me tu e lomadonu a qai mai tauri ena gauna ni Matai ni Valu kei na iKarua ni Valu vei ira na Jamani.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ena 1957 o Luxemburg a matai ni lewena na soqosoqo eda kila tu nikua na European Union.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Na Drukgyal Dzong e viribai vakacacani ka vanua ni masumasu vei ira na lotu Buddha ena muana e cake kei Paro District (ena koro o Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: E tukuni tu ena yabaki 1649, a bulia o Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel na bai me marautaka na nona wini mai vei ira na mataivalu ni Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ena 1951, a dua na kama e vakavuna me vo ga e vica na iyaya maroroi e Drukgyal Dzong, me vaka na itaba nei Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Ni oti na kama, a maroroi ka taqomaki na bai, e dua vei ira na saravanua totoka duadua e Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ena 18 na senituri kunea o Cambodia ni tiko vakavoleka ena kedrau maliwa o Thailand kei Vietnam, e rua na matanitu kaukauwa.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Era kabai Cambodia vaka vica vata na vanua o Thai ena 18 na senituri ka vakarusai Phnom Phen ena 1772.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Ena cavacava ni ka 18 ni senituri era qai kabai Cambodia o Vietnam.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Tinikawalu na pasede na kai Venezuela era sega ni cakacaka, ka vuqa vei ira era cakacaka e cakacaka ena vanua sega ni tuvai vinaka.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: E sivia e ono sagavula na pasede era cakacaka ena tabana ni veiqaravi, volekata e dua na ikava e cakacaka ena kabani ni buli yaya, ka dua mai na lima e cakacaka ena tabana ni teitei.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: E dua na vanua bibi ni buli yaya e Venezuela oya na waiwai, na matanitu e vakauta duadua e levu, dina ga ni dua ga na pasede e cakacaka ena tabana ni waiwai.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ena gauna se qai yaco kina na nodra tu galala, na dau ni loga ni kau ni wainimate e Singapore, a vukea na kena vakarairai vinaka taki na yanuyanu ki na dua na Siti vaka loga ni kau totoka ena vanua katakata.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ena 1981, na Vanda Miss Joaquim, e dua na seni okidi e tubu mai vei rua na kena mataqali a digitaki me senikau ni vanua.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Na veiyabaki ni sa roro mai na vula o Okotova, volekata e 1.5 na milioni na manumanu e kania na vunikau e mua ki na vanua e ra, takosovi na Uciwai Mara mai na delana ena vualiku me ra lakova mai na uca.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ka era lesu ki na vualiku mai na yasana ena ra, takosovi tale na uciwai Mara, ni oti na uca ena Epereli.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Na vanua o Serengeti e tiko kina na Rara ni Gade ni Vanua, na tikina Maroroi e Ngorongoro kei na Maswa Tikotiko ni manumanu kila e Tanzania kei na Maasai Mara tikina Maroroi ni Vanua e Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Na vulici ni kena buli na video oka kina na veivosaki e gadreva na kilaka vaka tekinoloji kei na ivakarau makawa, vaka kina na kilaka e yaco mai ena kena vulici na iyaya ni veivosaki (talanoa, rorogo, vidio, vakadodonutaki, etc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Na droinitaki ni Veitalanoa (interactive design) e gadreva me da raica tale mada na veika eda nanuma tu mai me baleta na valavala ni media ka vulica me rabailevu na vakasama.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Na droinitaki ni Veitalanoa e gadreva na gacagaca ni dua na cakacaka me ra sema vata kece, ka vakaibalebale talega kevaka me ra tu duadua.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Na leqa e tiko ena zoom lense ni dua na itaba oya na dredre ni rai vakamatata kei na levu ni gacagaca ni vadodorai e gadrevi me yacova e dua na tagede ni rai e levu cake sara mai vei koya na prime lense.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: E sa lailai tiko mai na leqa oqo baleta ni sa bulia na kena dau na lens e vakatorocaketaki na kena ituvaki ni buli.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Na veika oqo e vakatara me taura na zoom lense na itaba vinaka cake sara kevaka mo vakatautauvatataka kei na lens e tu vakadua na kena vadodorai.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Edua tale na leqa e tiko vua na zoom lenses oya na levu ni aperture (kena totolo) ni lens e tiko era.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Qo e vakavuna me dredre na vakayagataki ni zoom lense sau lailai kevaka e lailai na rarama ena vanua.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Dua na leqa levu ena kena dau sagai me veisataki na iyaloyalo ni DVD oya ne kena ivakatakilakila vakasivia.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: E vuqa na mona retioyaloyalo ka caka tiko e caka mera vakaloma vinaka taki kina na lewe ni vanua.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Na vuna, ni ka kece o raica e na retioyaloyalo e musiki tu na tutuna e cake, botona, kei na yasana.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Qo na ka e caka me vakadeitaka na kena roboti kece na iubi ni retiolivaliva. Na yacana na dikevisivia.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Dau veivakaleqai, na caka DVD, e rawa ni musuki talega na tutuna, kevaka e voleka na tutuna era na vosa volai ena vidio e dau dredre me laurai.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Na vale vakatui ni veigauna eliu e dau vakauqeta tu na vakanananu, ka dau tauyavutaka mai na iyaloyalo ni veisisivitaki ni itutu, soqo ni marau, kei na inaki ni lawalawa era tu taka na vakasama ni tui makawa o Aca.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: E dina ga ni da duri tu ena udolu na yabaki na vakacaca ni valu e rawarawa na kena lesu mai na iboi kei na rogorogo ni valu ena veigauna makawa oya, ka voleka ni rogo mai na vadugu ni dakai lelevu ni valu ka dau vakavuna na rere mai na vanua ni vuni.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ia, e yavutaki beka na noda vakanananu ena veika dina? Na cava era tara kina na vale vakatui? Era tauyavutaki ka tara vakacava?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Na veika a yaco ena gauna oya, na Vale vakatui nei Kirby Muxloe e vakataka e dua na vale viribaiti vinaka mai na kena vale vakatui dina.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Na kena katubaleka vakailoilo lelevu kei na lalaga mamare ena sega ni rawa ni taqomaka vakadede e dua na veiravuti nakiti.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ena 1480, na kena tekivu tara mai vei Lord Hastings, a vakanomodi tu na vanua ka gadrevi ga na tataqomaki mai vei ira na dau butako wavoki.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Na wasei vakatautauvata ni kaukauwa a dua na ivakarau era vakayagataka na veimatanitu e Iurope me ra taukena tikoga kina na lewa kei na kaukuwa levu duadua ena vei yasana e Iurope.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Na vakanananu ni o ira kece na matanitu e Iurope me ra saga me kakua ni dua ga na matanitu me kaukauwa duadua, o koya era dau veisautaka kina na matanitu yadua na nodra ito me wasei vinaka vakatautauvata.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Na iveitaravi ni Valu e Sipeni e makataka na imatai ni valu me ra raica na leqa levu ni kena sega ni wasei vakatautauvata na kaukauwa.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Oqo qai makataka na veisau bibi, ni sa na sega ni rawa ni bilitaki tiko na ivalu ni matalotu. O koya, e iotioti kina ni valu na ivalu ena loma ni Tolusagavulu na Yabaki me vakatokai kina na ivalu ni matalotu.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Na vale ni soro nei Artemis e Ephesus a vakarusai na ka 21 ni July, 356 B.K e nai naki ca nei Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ena kenai tukutuku, na nonai naki me rogo se mani vakacava na kena bibi. Na levu ni nodra cudru na kai Ephesus era sa kacivaka me kakua ni qai nanumi na yaca na Herostatus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Na dau ni vola itukutuku makawa ni Kirisi o Strabo a qai kunea na yacana, ka sa mai kilai tu kina nikua. Na vale ni soro a vakarusai na bogi vata ga a sucu kina o Alexander na Kaukauwa.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, na tui, sa bolea me sauma na kena tara tale na vale ni soro, a mani sega ni vakadonui na nona kerekere. Ni sa mate oti o Alexander sa qai tara tale na vale ni soro ena 323 B.K.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Mo qarauna na ligamu me malumu tuga na gauna o tabaka kina na ki dodonu - tovolea talega me kakua ni veitosoyaki vakaveitalia na nomu itaukuku ni liga.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Na sala oqo, ena vakalailaitaka na nomu oca. Nanuma e sega soti ni gadrevi mo tabaka vakaukauwa na ki, me vakalevutaka na rorogo me vaka na piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ena accordion, kevaka e gadrevi me vakalevutaki na rorogo, mo tabaka vakaukauwa ka vakatotolo na bellows.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Na Mysticism e dua na vakasaqaqara ni veitokani voleka, na nomu kilai iko vatakei, se na vakatakila raraba ni nona bula dina, na itutu va kalou, vaka yalo, se dina, se Kalou.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Na tamata vakabauta e vakasaqara e dua na veitaratara vakadodo, na vakatakila, se na kilaka ena veika dina vakalou/na kalou se veikalou.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Ira na vakabauta e ra vakamuria eso nai walewale ni bula, se ivakarau e vakainaki me bucini tiko na veika e lakocuruma.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Na Mysticism e rawa ni vakaduatanitaki mai na vakabauta eso kei na sokalou ena kena vakabibitaki na veiwekani voleka kei na dua na vakatakila duatani, vakabibi vei ira na tu vakacegu, vakasama raraba, mamarau, se na bula e dau reki vakalevu.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Na Sikhism e dua na lotu mai na vanua vaka Idia. A tauyavutaki mai na yasayasa vaka Punjab ena ika 15 ni sentueri mai na vakabauta vaka Hindu makawa.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: O ira na Sikhs era vakabauta ni duidui na nodra lotu mai vei ira na vakabauta vaka Hindu dina ga ni ra vakadinadinataka na kedra isema ena vakabauta vaka Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: O ira na Sikhs era vakatoka na nodra lotu me Gurmat, ena vosa vaka Punjabi na kena ibalebale na "nodra ivakarau na guru". Na guru sa ikoya na yavu tudei ni nodra lotu na Idia, ia o ira na Sikh e vakabibitaka me yavu ni nodra vakabauta.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: A yavutaki na lotu ena ika 15 ni senituri mai vei Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Era qai veitaravi mai e ciwa taucoko na guru.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Ia, ena June 1956, na veika a yalataka o Krushchev’s era a vakatovolei ena vakacaca mai Poland, era kudruvaka na tamata cakacaka na lailai ni kakana kei na musu ni kedra sau, ka mani yaco na kudru me baleta na Communism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: E dina ga, sa qai vakauta o Krushchev na taqenivalu me vakameautaka na yavavala, a vakamalumalumu taka na ka vaka iyau ka vakadonuya me digitaki o Wladyslaw Gomulka me
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Na veivakararamataki ena Indus Valley a sucu mai ena veivakararamataki ena gauna ni Bronze Age ena Ra-ni-Vualiku kei Idia ena gauna vou kei Pakistan kei na yasayasa ena Ra-kei-Vualiku e Idia kei na Tokalau-Vualiku kei Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Na veivakararamataki e tete e na vei beseni ka sucu mai kina na Indus River, na vanua e sucu mai kina na yacana.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Dina ga ni eso na daunivuku era vakanananu taka ni na gauna a yaco kina na veivakararamataki ena vei beseni koya sa Uciwai o Sarasvati koya sa mamaca tu nikua, e dodonu me vakatokai na veivakararamataki ni Indus-Sarasvati, dina eso era vakatoka na Veivakararamataki nei Harappan ni oti o Harappa, na imatai ni vanua me keli ena 1920s.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Na veika vakaivalu ena matanitu vakaroma e vukea na kena vakatorocaketaki na itabana ni bula.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: E a tekivu vakacurumi ira na vuniwai ko Emperor Augustus ka tauyavu kina na imatai ni Roman Medical Corps me ra vakayagataki ni cava na ivalu.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: O ira na dau ni veisele era kila na veimataqali wainimate ni veivakamoceri me vakataka na morphine koya e caka mai na waiwai ni sore ni poppy kei na scopolamine mai na sore ni kau gaga.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Era sa matai sara na veisele mera vakabula na tauvimate mai na draka ni yago vaka talega na ivesu edau tarova na drodro ni dra kei na isogo me veisautaka na sala ni dra.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: E vuqa na senituri sa oti, na matanitu vaka Roma era liutaka na vakadidike ni tabana ni wainimate ka sa yavu tu ni kilaka vaka vuniwai e daidai.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Na Pureland origami e vakatara ga e dua na ilobi ena dua na gauna, e vuqa na ilobi vaka na ilobi e muri e sega ni vakatarai kei na ilobi kece ena vakadodonu ga.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: E a vakamacalata o John Smith ena 1970 me vukei ira era sega ni kila na lobilobi se o ira e lailai na kila na kena moici ni qaqalo ni liga.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Ni ra tubu tiko mai na gone era sa vulica tiko eso nai valavala e dau kauta mai na veivakaduiduitaki ni se ra gone ka rawa ni vakacacana na nodrai tovo.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Taura mada o ira na gone era gone ni dua na kawa e lailai na kedra iwiliwili era vakawai ni ra sega ni caka vinaka e koronivuli edau yaco me ra sega dina ni caka vinaka e koronivuli na gauna era dau mai kila kina na veivakaduiduitaki e dau yaco baleta na nodra kawa.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: Na MySpace e katolu ni mataveilawa kilai levu e Amerika ka kovuta e 54 na milioni era vaka ivola yaca kina ena gauna oqo.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Na mataveilawa oqo era sa kauwaitaki vakalevu sara, vakabibi ena ituvaki ni vuli.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: E tiko eso na yasana vinaka ni mataveilawa oqo, oka kina, na rawarawa ni tauyavutaki ni dua na tabana ni kalasi, e wili kina na buloqi, vidio, itaba, kei na so tale na tabana vakaraitaki.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Na tabana oqo e rawa ni dolavi rawarawa kevaka me vakarautaki e dua na yaca e nanumi rawarawa ni mataveilawa ka rawarawa talega mera nanuma na gonevuli koya e dredre vei ira na vakayagataka na papa ni taipa se na wilivola.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: E rawa ni moici me vakarawarawataka na kena wiliki vaka talega kina kevaka e gadrevi me lailai sobu se levu cake na kena roka
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Na Attention Deficit Disorder "e dua na leqa ni vakasama , na kena vakatakilakila kilai e wili kina na totolo ni nomu vakatulewa, yali totolo na yalomu, kei na sivia ni nomu igu.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: E sega ni vakaleqa na nomu kilaka, e vakaleqa ga na nomu vuli; e vakaleqa tu e 3-5 na pasede ni gone kece, na kena levu erawa ni 2 na milioni na gone ni Amerika.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: O ira na gone e tiko vei ira na ADD e dredre me ra raica dede e dua na itavi me vakataka na cakacaka ni vuli, ia e rawa ni ra raica dede tu e dua na ka era taleitaka me vaka na qito ena video se sarava na nodra yaloyalo taleitaki se na volavola yatuvosa e sega ni toqai.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: O ira na gone oqo e dau rawarawa me ra dau leqa, baleta ni ra "vakaitavi ena itovo ca, veivacu, kei na dredre sotavi kei ira era tiko na nodra dodonu" me rawa kina ni yavalati na mona baleta e sega ni rawa ni yavalati na mona ena ivakarau makawa.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Na ADD e rawa ni vakaleqa na veimaliwai kei eso tale na gone baleta o ira na gone ena sega ni kila se cava na vuna e duatani kina na itovo se na cava era sipeli taka kina na vosa ena vakarau duidui se era duidui na itagede ni nodra vakayalo.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Na kena veisau na rawati ni vuli kei na kilaka ena dua na ivakarau e sivia mai na kena yavutaki na kilaka e veisautaka na ka e rawati.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Na sasaga mo tauri tukutuku e duatani. Sa oti na gauna e dau vakila kina e dua na nuiqawaqawa me lesuva na nona nanuma, ia na lesuvi ni text esa da vakanamata ga kina.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: O koya e vakayacora kina na Renaissance e dua na veisau levu ena kena sasagataki na vuli kei na veiwaseiyaki ni kilaka.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Sega ni vaka eso tale na manumanu, o ira na hominids era sega ni vakayagataka na ligadra me ra yavavala se kedra bibi me ra lilili kina e vunikau.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Na ligana kei na yava ni chimpanzee era lailai na kedra levu kei na kena balavu, vakasamata tiko na vakayagataki ni qaqalo ni ligadra me ra taubale kina.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Na liga ni tamata e lekaleka mai na yava ka dodonu kece na kena qaqalo.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Na sui makawa ni rua se tolu na milioni na yabaki sa oti e vakaraitaka na toso e yaco ena kena vakatabakiduataki na toso ni liga mai na dua na vanua ki na dua tale ka sa lei yaco qo me bulia saraga na ka vakaimatailalai na liga.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: E so e ra vakabauta ni vakavuna na oca, kevaka e dua e sivia na nona vakila tiko na tadra e nakiti.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Na vuna levu ga ni veika e veivakurabuitaki qo, na kena matata tiko mai na veitadra ka vakavuna na balavu ni moce yadrayadra ni mona.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Na lailai ni nomu moce yadrayadra ena veibogi ka vuna na nomu tatadra voli, ena rawa ni yaco kina na oca se malumalumu ni yago ka na rawa ni vakaleqai sara kina na bula.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: E sa bau vakaoca yago kei na vakasama na yadrayadra tiko ena vei ya ruasagavulu se tolusagavulu na miniti ena sara retioyaloyalo.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Na kena ivakaraitaki e vakatau ki na levu ni gauna e sasaga kina na mona me vakamatatataka na veika e tadrai tiko e na veibogi.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Mai na matai ni gauna a sa bau sotava na dredre o ratou na kai Itali ka tiko ena Mua i Cake e Aferika. Ena loma ga ni dua na macawa ni mai vakaro taki kina nai valu levu o Itali ena ka 10 ni June 1940, o ratou na ika 11 ni Hussars kei Peretania a mai qaqa ka sa vakatulewa ena Fort Capuzzo kei Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Ena dua na veiliumuri taki ena vualiku kei Bardia, a mai toboki na ka Tini ni Komada ni Valu e Itali, General Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ena ka 28 ni June, o Marshal Italo Balbo, na Kovana-Liuliu e Libya ka yalataki me sosomi taki Mussolini, a mate vakasakasaka mai vei dua ga na kai nona ena nona sa qai kele i Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Na qito na fencing e levu na gaunisala e qitori kina, vei ira na gonevuli era vuli tiko ena Univesiti me lai yaco sara vei ira na keda dau ena isotasota ni Olympic.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: E dau vakalevu me rau na qitora e le rua, e dua ena saga me valuta na kena ikarua.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Ena vinakati ena qito golf mo wakoca na polo ena dua na kena ikaukamea.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Me na sagai ena dua na qito me vakacurumi na polo ena 18 na qara, tekivu mai na kena imatai me lai cava sara ena kena iotioti.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: O koya e lailai duadua na nona samuta na polo ena gauna e oti kina na qito ena wini.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Ena caka na qito ena dela ni veico e koti vakalekaleka qai dau vakatokai me green se drokadroka.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: E levu na saravanua e dau nodra ivakarau: Mera lako tu ga vakagade.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Qori na nodra lako eso ena dua na vanua e vou qai duiatani mai na ka era dau vakayacora e veisiga mera lai gade ga mera marau.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Era dau goleva vakalevu na saravanua era lako ga vakagade na matasawa, vanua era dau caka kina e levu na ka ni veivakamarautaki kei na vanua ni keba.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Ke dua na inaki ni nona gade e dua me lai vulica na itovo vakavanua kei na keina itukutuku makawa, qori era dau kilai mera saravanua ni itovo kei na ivakarau vakavanua.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Era na dau taleitaka na saravanua mera gole wavoki mera raica na veika eso e kilaitani kina e dua na vanua se mera lai rai ga ena dua na vanua.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Era kere veivuke o ira na butuvanua nira raiwa na veika qori.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: O ira na mataivalu era tokona tiko na iyatu e liu e tiko tale ga kina na imatai kei na ika3 ni mataivalu ni New Hampshire, ena ruku ni nodra veiliutaki o John Stark kei James Reed (erau qai mai Jenereli ruarua).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: O ira na tagana nei Stark era tuva e yasa ni bai ena vualiku ni vanua era tiko kina na butuvanua.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Ena gauna e di kina na mati e galala vakailaia e dua na ucuna ena yasani Uicwai na Mystic ena vuaira ni yanuyanu, era mani vakuria na bai ena dua na lalaga vatu lailai me lai yacova sara na iyala ni vanua ena dua na baravi lailai.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: E mani tekitaka e dua na ivakatakilakila o Gridley se o Stark ena rauta na 100 na fiti (30 na mita) ena mata ni bai qai vakarota me kua ni dua e vana nona gasau me yacova nira lako sivita na sotia.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: E saga na Matanitu o Merika me viribai mai na tolu na vanua, ia me tuvanaki vinaka na sala me ravuravu kina.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: O Jenerali John Cadwalder me saga me vakacalai ira na mataivalu ni Peretania mai Bordentown, me rawa ni sogota na sala ni veivuke.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: O Jenerali James Ewing me na kauta e 700 na lewe ni mataivale mera takosova na Trenton Ferry, taura vakaukaua na wavu ena tai ni Uciwai na Assunpink qai vesuki ira na meca mera kua ni dro rawa.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Na matatimi ni ravuravu era lewena e 2,400 na tagane era na takosova na uciwai me rauta ni 9 na maile ena vualiku kei Trenton, ra qai wase vakarua, dua ena ruku ni veiliutaki nei Greene kei na dua tale nei Sullivan, me rawa nira ravuravu ni bera ni kacabote na rarama.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ni rawa ni veisau totolo na nodra gutuwa, e bibi cake na nodra sasaga mera bula mai na nodra tolotolo.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: E macala ni dua e kenadau ena cici ena veimama ni maile, e rawa ni cici me lailai na rua na miniti, ena vinakati me totolo sara, ia ena vinakati me qaqarauni qai vosota na veigauna kece,
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: E veivuke ena vakavakarau na veitaucici na cici takoso ena so na vanua ena vula ibatabata kei na tereni vakaukaua, vakabibi mai na toloda ina tabada.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Na kakana bulabula e rawa ni veivuke me kaukaua vinaka yago, ena yaga tale ga vakalevu vei ira na dauveitaucici gone.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ena veivuke ena nona vakaitavi vinaka kei na nona marautaka na qito e dua na dauqito ke veiraurautaka na ka e kania kei me isosomi igu sa yali, me dau gunu wai vakavinaka, kei na nona kila vakayagataka na kakana kei na wainimate eso e yaga i yagodra.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: E sega ni sau levu na vakaitavi ena veitaucici balavu, ia e levu na rai cala e basika me baleta na vica na iyaya e gadrevi mo rawa kina ni vakaitavi.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: E rawa ni voli na veika e gadrevi, ia ena sega ni lai vakavinakataka sara na nomu vakaitavi.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Era na rairai vakayagataka ga na iyaya qori na vakaitavi kevaka mada ga e sega ni yaga vei ira .
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: E tukuni ni atomi e yavu ni ibulibuli eso me vaka na wai, kasi, kei na veika o rawa ni tara.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ena dua na kena iyaloyalo rawarawa me vakamacalataka na vereverea ni veika qo, e toka e loma na nucleus qai cowiri wavokita na electrons, e via vaka ga na kena cowiri wavokita na matanisiga na vuravura - raica na iYaloyalo 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: E rua na ka e tiko ena nucleus - na neutrons kei na protons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Na protons e tiko kina na igu vakalivaliva na positive kei na neutrons e sega ni dua na kena kaukaua. Na electrons e tiko kina na igu vakalivaliva na negative.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Mo rawa ni dikevi koya e mavoa, mo raica rawa na veika e tu wavoliti koya me kua ni dua na ke e rawa ni veivakaleqai.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Mo na raica vakavinaka na kena ituvaki o koya e mavoa ni o volekati koya qai raica ke tiko e dua na ituvaki leqataki.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Ke o mani mavoa ni o via veivuke tiko sa na qai vakadredretaka ga na ituvaki.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: E laurai ena vakadidke ni o ira na lomabibi, ira dau taqaya, kei ira na dau cala tu ga nodra nanuma e lai vakavuna ruarua na mosi kei na paralasi ni suitu ni dakudra.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Na ituvaki duadua ga e lai dikevi kina e veimacawa ena PA e dua ke vakila na revurevu ni cala ni rai, sega ni o ira na lomabibi kei ira na dau taqaya.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: O ira na vakaitavi kina era gadreva e levu na veitokoni ena vuku ni rai cala me baleta na mosi, me kila na duidui ni mosi dede e rawa ni vu mai na so tale na ka kei na mosi ni veitosoyaki.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ena vakatau a noda rai ena ituvatuva ni kena cakacaka na masela ni mata.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: E levu na mataqali sala e buli kina na matada, ena vakatau na ka e gadrevi vua e dua n ka bula.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: E duidui na ka e rawa ni cakava na ibulibuli ni mata, na kaukaua ni mata e dau vakatau ena duidui mataqali rorogo, ena duidui tale ga na sala e cakacaka kina na masela ni yagodra mera kila na ka e tukuni kei na sala me fikataki kina na ka e vinakati.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Na iwiliwili e okati kina e dua ga na mataqali manumanu era tiko vata ena dua na vanua.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Ke tautauvata na ivakarau ni ka era cakava e dua na iwasewase ni kabula ena vuku ni kedra ibulicaki e dau kilai me monomorphic.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Ke laurai na duidui ni ivakarau ena vica na kabula ena dua na iwasewase, e vakatokai qori me polymorphic.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: E duidui tale ga na gauna era maji qai tara kina na nodra bure na kadi.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Nira toki wavoki, era dau maji ena bogi na mataivalu kadi ra qai dau keba ena mataka.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Era dau toki na kadi ke sa sega ni levu ka kedra. Ena gauna qori era dau tara na nodra bure mera tiko kina vakalekaleka, e dau veiveisau na vanua e dau tu kina.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Era na maji se veitokiyaki va qori me 17 taucoko na siga.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Na cava na sela? Na vosa na sela e vu mai na vosa vakaLatina na “cella” kena ibalebale “rumu lailai”, a bulia na vosa qori e dua e dau vakadidike ena microscope ni dikeva tiko ibulibuli ni kuli ni vuni oki.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Na sela e tiko vei keda kece na kabula, na kabula kece e buli ena dua se vica vata na sela.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Na sela e dua na tiki bibi ni kena dikevi na bula, e kilai mada ga me “veika e tauyavu kina na bula”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: E veiraurau vinaka na iTuvatuva ni noda nave ni vakauta na nave eso e gadrevi ina yagoda taucoko me drodro tiko ga kina na dra, me kua tale ga ni dua na ka e vakalatilati.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Na nave qo e totolo ga na kena vakau in yago taucoko, qori e vukea me taqomaki vinaka na yago mai na dua na ka e rawa ni veivakaleqai.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Na covulaca e rawa ni vakacaca vakalevu ena dua ga na vanua lailai ni vakatauvatani kei na cagilaba kaukaua tale eso.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: E rawa ni cavuraka na vunikau na covulaca, basuraka na lalana ni vale qai viritaka e macawa na motoka. E rua na pasede ni covulaca kaukaua sara e rawa ni sivia e tolu na aua na kena dede.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Na cagi kaukaua qo e rawa ni yacova e 480 na kilomita dua aua na kena totolo (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Era sa dau vakayagataka sara tiko mai na tamata na iloilo ni vakalevutaki ka me vica vata na udolu na yabaki.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Ia, na imatai ni telescope a buli mai Urope ena icavacava ni ika16 nii senitiuri.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: E tiko ena telescope qo e rua na iloilo, dua me raica voleka e dua na ka, dua tale me raica vakayawa.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Eda na bula vata tu ga kei na kocokoco kei na tawaveinanumi, qori na nodra ivakarau na isoqosoqo eso ni levu ga era na nanumi ira qai lekaleka ga na kena yaga.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: E nuitaki ni levu era na kila ni na yaga sara vakalevu ke ra dau cakacaka vata.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: E levu era tadra ni dua na siga ena rawa vua na tamata me gole ena dua tale na kalokalo qai lai raica eso tale na vuravura. Era dau veinanuyaka eso na ka e tu ena dua tale na vuravura, eso era vakabauta ni tiko na alien se dua tale na kabula ena dua tale na vuravura.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ke nanuma mada ga ni yaco ena sega ni rawa ni yaco ena dua na gauna balavu sara. Sa rui veiyawaki na kalokalo ni tirilioni na maile na kedrau veiyawaki e dua na kalokalo kei na kalokalo e toka e “yasana”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: De dua ena dua na siga, o ira na makubumu era na duri tu ena dua nodra vuravura na alien ra qai vakasamataki ira na tubudra?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Era buli ena levu na sela na manumanu. Era kania qai qaqi e ketedra na kakana. E levu na manumanu era rawa ni toso.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: O ira ga na manumanu e tiko nodra mona (e macala ni sega ni manumanu kece; me vaka na salato ni waitui, e sega ni tiko nona mona)
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Era tiko an manumanu e veiyasai vuravura. Era dau kelikeli, qalo e waitui se vuka e macawa.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Na sela e ituvatuva somidi kei na tikina duadua e cakacaka tiko ena bula ni dua na ka bula.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Na sela e vu mai na vosa vakaLatina na cella e kena ibalebale rumu lailai.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Ke o raica na kabula ena iloilo ni vakalevutaki ka somidi, o na raica nira buli tu ena sikuea se polo lalai.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: O Robert Hooke, e dua na dau dikeva na kabula mai Igiladi, e raica na sikuea lalai ena kuli ni vuni oki.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: E vaka na irairai ni rumu. E matai ni tamata me dikeva na sela mate.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Na tiki ni ibulibuliu e sega ni rawa ni veisau ni toki mai na dua na ituvaki ina dua tale.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Na kasi na nitrogen e tiko tale ga kina na veika e tiko ena liquid nitrogen. E macala ni mamada cake na wai ni nitrogen ia e sega ni veisau na molecules e tiko kina.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Na wai tale ga e dua na ivakaraitaki. Na wai e buli mai na rua na atomi ni hydrogen kei na dua na atomi ni cagi.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: E tautauvata se sega ni veisau na kena ituvatuva kevaka e kasi, wai se ka e rawa ni tarai.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Ena rawa ni veisau na kedra irairai, ia ena tautauvata tiko ga na ka e tu kina.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: E lewai keda na gauna qai tu wavoliti keda, ia e dredre meda kila.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Era dikeva na lotu, vuku kei na saenitisi ena vica na udolu na yabaki sa sivi na gauna.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Eda vakila na gauna me vaka na ituvatuva ni ka e dau yaco, mai na gauna e liu, noda gauna ina gauna makawa.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Eda na dau vakatauvatana na kena oti e dua na ituvaki ena gauna.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: O rawa ni kila na kena toso na gauna ni o vakaraica na veika e dau yaco tu ga. Na veika e yaco tu ga e sega vakadua ni veisau.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Sa vakayagataki na kompiuta me vakaraitaka na itaba kei na iyaloyalo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: E levu na iyaloyalo yavala vereverea e rawa ni buli ena kompiuta, sa ra vakayagataki sara vakalevu nikua ena tivi kei na iyaloyalo.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Sa katoni vakalevu na ivakatagi ena kompiuta vereverea me maroroya qai wakia vata na rorogo.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Ena rauta na ikatinikaciwa kei na ikaruasavulu ni senitiuri e vakabauti tu mai kina nira imatai ni tamata mera tawana na vanua o Niusiladi na kai Maori, era dau vakasasataka na manumanu vuka levu na moa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Sa qai mai vakadeitaki ena vakasama qoi ni o ira na Maori era toki mai Polinisia ena dua na kalia qai ravuti ira na Morimori e Niusiladi, oti era mani teivaka sara na vanua.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Ia e laurai ena so na ivakadinadina vou ni o ira na na Morimori era dua na ilawalawa kai Maori era toki mai Niusiladi ina Chatham Islands, era qai tekivuna ga na nodra ivakarau kei na itovo vakavanua.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: E tiko tale ga e dua na yavusa e Chatham islands, qo o ira na kai Maori e biubiu mai Niusiladi.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Era vakayacani ira ga na Morimori ia mani basika na duidui ena kedra maliwa, toso na gauna sa mai qeavu yani vakadua na Morimori.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: O ira na vakaitavi me vica vata na yabaki era vukei keda meda raica na ka eda vinaka kina kei na ka e da taleitaka, era vukei keda tale ga nira vosa vakadodonu ena veika eda lekata kei na veika dredre eda sotava.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ni vakarogoci o ira eso mera wasea na veika era sotava, veika me baleta nodra vuvale kei na isoqosoqo, eda kila kina na veika e yaco ena gauna sa oti kei na itovo ni rai eso e veiuqeti se vakaleqa e dua na isoqosoqo.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Eda na sega ni kila na ivakarau e susugi kina e dua nida kila wale ga na veika e baleti koya ena veigauna sa oti, eda rawa ni bau kila mada ga kina na vanua era tekivu kina ena dua na isoqosoqo.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Ni kilai dikevi na veika e lekati kei na veika e rawati, e rawa kina vua e dua se o koya sara ga e vakaitavi me kila vinaka na inaki, vanua e mua kina kei na veika e tosoya rawa e dua na isoqosoqo.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ena vuku ni ituvaki qo, na kena dikevi na sasaga ni toso ni dua na bisinisi kei na nodra rawaka, e vukei ira eso mera ciqoma na veisau kei na vanua sa mua kua kina e dua na lotu.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Na italanoa ni rawaka va qori e uqeta eso mera doudou qai veiuqeti tale ga me tiko vua e dua na rai donu me baleta na veigauna se bera mai.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Na vei semati ni vakasama e gaunisala ni kena wali ka vakaduavata taki na duidui nanuma se rai me kune kina na kena wali.
