text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Na kena vakatabakiduataki na vakanananu oqo e oka kina na totolo, vakaibalebale kei na dodonu, vaka talega kina na kena vakatakilakilataki nai tukutuku dina, vakayagataki ni waliwali era tiko rawa, kei na kumuni ni tukutuku.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Na veika bibi duadua ni vakasama oqo ni: dua ga na sau ni taro donu. E rua ga na sau ni taro o na vakasamataka mai, e dua e donu ka dua ena cala.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Na vakasama vaka oqo e semati vata kei na so na vakadidike se na vakavakarau taumada.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Ko ira na tamata era vakasama vaka oqo edau vakaibalebale na nodra rai, ka rawa kina mera kilamatata na veikanukanu eso ni valavala, walia na leqa ka cakacakataka na veitarogi ni vakadidike.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Na tamata duadua ga e ibulibuli vakasakiti duadua ena kena rawa ni kila na nodra nanuma eso tale.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: E kena ibalebale eda rawa ni kila vinaka na ka e nanuma tiko e dua, ka e vinakata, vakabauta, kila se gadreva.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Mai na ka eda rawa ni vakaycora qori, e bibi dina na noda kila na nodra inaki eso tale. Ena vukei keda meda walia na duidui e basika ena veika eso e vakayacori.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Kena ivakaraitaki, ke o raica e dua e voraka tiko na iloilo ni motoka, o rawa ni siqema ni via butako.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Ena veisau na rai qo ke vakayalia na nona ki ni motoka qai basuka tiko ga na nona motoka ni tiko kina na ki.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Na MRI e vu mai na vulici ni bula kei na veika e buli kina na vuravura e vakatokai na nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), erau kunea o Felix Bloch (cakacaka tiko ena Univesiti o Stanford ) kei Edward Purcell (mai na Univesiti o Harvard) ena 1930 vakacaca.
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ena gauna e yavala kina na misini qor, na idre ni vuravura na kei na uaua ni sikinala e vakavuna e solia tale ga kina na atomi eso na sikinala lalai ni idre ni vuravura.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ena yabaki 1970, e dikeva rawa e dua na vuniwai, e daunivakadidike tale ga o Raymond Damadian, na yaga ni kena yavala na idre se makeneta me tabaka na ka me vakayagataki ena veiqaravi vakavuniwai.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ni oti tale e 4 na yabaki e vakadonui me vakayacori vua e dua na tamata, qo na imatai ni tauvimate e vakaycori vua na MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Ena 1977 a vakacavara kina o Vuniwai o Damian na imatai ni itaba ni MRI ni “yago taucoko,” e vakatoka me “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Na veitaratara ena monlivaliva e uqeta na gauna me vakasama kina eso ra qai tukuna na ka era nanuma.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: E vukei ira na gonevuli mera cakacaka ga vakataki ira qai lewa na nodra rawa ni ciqoma na itukutuku e vakarautaki.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Kena ikuri e sega ni lewai ira na gauna, qai rawa nira cakacaka ena gauna cava ga. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Na vakayagataki ni Internet kei na World Wide Web e rawa kina vei ira na gonevuli mera vutuniyau ena itukutuku.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Era rawa ni taro vei ira na qasenivuli na gonevuli ena gauna ga era vinakata kina ena dua na siga qai dau saumi vakatotolo na kedra isau, mai na nodra waraka tale tiko e dua na siga mera veiraimata kina.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Na ivakarau vou ni veivakavulici e galala kina e dua me cakava na ka vinakata. E sega ni dua tu ga na ivakarau ni veivakavulici.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Na kena dina e sega ni vulici ga e dua na ka e vinaka. Na vuli ena laurai kina na ka e sotava o koya e vuli kei na veika e vulica.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Na veika eda sotava ena vuku ni itukutuku kaburaki ni cakava ga vakataki iko e laurai ena iyaloyalo e vakaraitaka na tikina qo.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: E levu vei keda eda na sarava na porokaramu ni tivi ena vakaraitaka vei keda e dua na ivakarau se veika e sotavi eda na sega ni vakaitavi kina se vakayagataka na kena kila.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Eda na sega ni vakavoutaka na irairai ni dua na motoka, cakava e dua na ivurevure ni wai ena daku ni noda vale, veisiko i Peru meda dikeva na veika makawa se vakavouta na vale ni noda itokani.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ena vuku ni keveli ni fiber e takoso ena waitui i Urope kei na satellite, era sema vinaka ena internet e rauta ni 93 na pasede na lewe i Greenland.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Nomu otela se o vakaicili vua e dua (ke o tiko ena dua na rumu ni vulagi se vale vakaitaukei) ena rawa ni tiko na wifi se internet in kompiiuta, e tiko ena veikorokoro kece na vanua e dau vakarautaki kina na internet saumi se so na vanua e tiko kina na wifi e vakarautaki vei ira na lewenivanua.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Me vaka sa cavuti oti, e dina ga na vosa na “ Eskimo” e vakayagataki talega i Amerika, e vosa veibeci vei ira na lewenivanua mai na Vualikuecake, vakabibi o ira mai Kenada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: E dina ga ni ra vakayagataka vakalevu o ira na lewenivanua mai Qiriniladi na vosa qo, ia e vakatabui me da vakayagataka na vulagi.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: O ira na itaukeinivanua e Qiriniladi, era vakatokai ira mera Inuiti mai Kenada kei na Kalaalleq (lewelevu-Kalaallit) na kai Qiriniladi, mai Qiriniladi.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: E sega ni kilai ena vanua o Greenland na basulawa se mera cati na vulagi. E sega mada ga ni dua na vanua “voravora” e laurai ena veitaoni.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: O ira na sega ni vakavakarau vinaka yani era rawa ni namaka na draki batabata.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Kevaka o sikovi Greenland ena draki batabata (na balavu ga ni nomu muria na gaunisala ena vualiku na kena batabata), e bibi gona me kau tiko na isulu katakata.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Na balavu ni siga ena vulaikatakata e rawa ni vakavuna mo sega ni moce vakavinaka qai rawa ni vakavu tauvimate.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Me qarauni tale ga na namu na Nordic ena vulaikatakata. E sega ni vakavu tauvimate ia e rawa ni vakaninivaki.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Na toso vinaka ni bula vakailavo e San Francisco e vakavuna me levu era dau gade kina mai veiyasai vuravura, e rabailevu na gaunisala ni rawa ilavo.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Na vanua veivakacakacakataki levu duadua na bisinisi era vakarautaka na kenadau ena veiqaravi, na matanitu, tabana ni veivoli, kei na saravanua.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Na kena dau vakaraitaki vakalevu ena sere, iyaloyalo, ivola kei na vakatasuasua eso ena gauna qo sa lai kilai levu kina na siti qo e veiyasai vuravura.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Na vanua o San Francisco e sa tara e levu na veivale lelevu vei ira na saravanu kei na vicavata na otela kei na valenikana, kei na veivanua ni soqo lelevu.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Na vanua o San Francisco e dua na vanua vinaka duadua e dau vakarautaki kina na kakana vakaEsia: vaKorea, vakaThai, vakaIdia, kei na vakaJapani.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Na nodra gade ina Walt Disney e dua na ka era da diva tu e levu na vuvale e Merika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: O ira na vakayacora na veisiko qori era vuka ena rara ni waqavuka e Orlando, era vodoka na basi ni Otela e Disney, ra qai tiko kina me dua na macawa nira sega ni biubiu mai kina, ra qai lesu tale ena nodra vale.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: E tiko e vicavata na ka e rawa ni yaco, ia qo e vica na ka era vakaibalebaletaka na tamata nira tukuna nodra “lako e Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: E levu na tikite e volitaki ena mona livaliva kei na website me vakataki eBay se Craiglist era sa dau vakayagataki toka vakalailai ena kena lade mai na dua na vanua ni sarasara ina dua tale.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: E macala ni dau yaco vakalevu qori, e vakatabui e Disney na ivakarau qori ni sega ni rawa ni dau pasitaki na tikite.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: O ira kece na via keba e bati ni Veibuca Lagilagi e gadreva na pepa ni sikovanua.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: E vakaiyalayala ga na ivolatara baleta na kena vinakati me taqomaki na buca, ka dau soli tiko ena ika 1 ni vula o Janueri, va na vula ni sebera ni dola.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Na pepa ni sikovanua ni vula o Me e dau soli tiko ena 1 ni Janueri.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Na vanua ni keba rogo levu me vaka na Bright Angel Campground ka tiko kabita na Phantom Ranch, e dau oso vakatotolo mai na gauna e dola kina na vanua taqomaki.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: E vakaiyalayala ga na pepa ni veivakadonui e soli vei ira na via sikova na vanua taqomaki, ka na soli ga vei ira na kerekere iliu.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Nida vodo motoka e Sauca Aferika, qo e dua na sala vinaka mo raica kina na totoka ni vanua, wili kina na nomu lako ena vanua era dau goleva e levu na saravanua.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: E rawa ni o cakava qori ena dua ga na mataqali motoka, ia e vakaturi vakabibi na lori na 4x4 qai levu na vanua era rawa ni dau golevi ga ena taya cere ni lori 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Me vakasamatataki tiko ena gauna e caka tiko kina na ituvatuva ni macala ni vinaka tu na ituvaki ni bula e South Africa, na veivanua tale eso e sega ni dua na kena leqa.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Ena duidui na isau ni Visa mai na dua na matanitu ina dua tale qai dau vakatau qori ena matanitu o gole mai kina.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Na matanitu yadua e tiko ga na kedra dui lawa ena ka e vaca na iyaragi me tiko ena motoka ke mani yaco e dua na ituvaki.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Na Baranisavu o Victoria e dua na taonie ena ra kei Zimbabwe, veibasai na iyala ni vanua mai Livingstone, Zambia, qai voleka i Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: E toka voleka sara ga ena taoni qori e dua na baranisavu, ra qai dau icurucuru ni vanua kila. Ia na vanua qo e dau nodra igadigadi na saravanua vakabibi vei ira na dau taleitaka mera gade mera lai dikeva na vanua kei ira na taleitaka na sarava na vanua, nira na marautaka mera na tiko tale vakalailai.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Donuya na vula iucauca (Noveba ina Maji), ena dau tubu totolo sara na levu ni wai ena Baranisavu.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: O na suasua ke o takosova na wavu se muria na gaunisala volekata na Baranisavu.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ena yasana adua, o na sega ni rawa ni raici vinaka na Baranisavua ena vuku ni tubu ni wai!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Na Sau Tabu nei Tutankhamun (KV62). Na KV62 e dua na sau tabu rogo ena Veibuca, na nona vakadidike o Howard Carter ena 1922 ni vanua ni bulubulu ni tui gone qo e se tu vinaka tu.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Ni vakatauvatani kei na ira na vo ni sau tabu ni tui, na sau tabu nei Tutankhamun e sega sara ga ni vinaka me lai sikovi ni lailai toka ga qai sega ni ukutaki vakalevu.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ke dua e vinakata me lai raica na vakacacani ni yago ni mummy ena kena sagai me kau laivi mai na kena kisi ena sega so ni marau ni na laurai ga na uluna kei na tabana.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Na iyau levu e tu ena sau tabu sa sega tale ni tu kina ni sa lai biu ena Vale ni iYaya Maroroi e Cairo Ijipita.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: O ira na vulagi e sega ni levu sara na nodra gauna ena vinaka me gole ena dua tale na vanua.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: O Phnom Krom e 12 na kilomita ena cevaira kei Siem Reap. A se tara sara na valenisoro ena dela qo ena icavacava ni ika9 ni senitiuri, ena gauna ni veiliutaki nei Tui Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Na kabukabu ni veidelana mai na valenisoro qo kei na kena sarava vinaka toka na drano o Tonle Sap e yaga sara ga kina na taubale ena baba.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: O rawa tale ga ni vodo waqa ena drano ni o veisiko ena veidelana qo.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Ena vinaka na Pasi na Angkor mo rawa ni curu ena valenisoro, kua gona ni guilecava mo kauta tiko nomu pasipote ni o gole e Tonie Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: E siti levu daudua ena koroturaga kei Jerusalemi o Isireli, e macala ni levu na matanitu kei na Matabose kei Vuravura era sega ni dau raica me koroturaga kei Isireli.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Na siti makawa ena veidelana mai Jutia e levu na kena itukutukuku makawa ena vicavata na udolu na yabaki sa oti.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Na siti tabu vei iran a tolu na vakarau ni vakabauta - vakaJiu, vaKarisito kei na Islam, qai vanua e dau golevi vei ira na sokalou, kilai ni ivakarau ni vanua kei na bula vakayalo.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ni kilai me vanua vakalotu na siti, vakabibi e levu na vanua ni sarasara ena Siti Makawa, e dau nodra igadigadi na saravanua na vanua o Jerusalemi e Isireli.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: E levu na vanua makawa e tiko e Jerusalemi, irusarusa ni vanua kei na koro makawa, e levu tale ga na vanua ni volivoli, na cafés kei na valenikana.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ena vinakata na matanitu o Ecuador vei ira na lewenivanua e Cuba mera taura rawa e dua na ivola ni veisureti ni bera nira sobu yani ena rara ni waqavuka e Equador se na icurucuru ni vanua.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ena vinakati me ivola vakadonui mai na Ministry of Foreign Affaris e Ecuador, mera muria tale ga na ivakatagedegede kece e vinakati.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: E muri na ituvatuva qo me rawa ni tuvanaki matau kina na levu ni tamata era dui curu yani ena matanitu ruarua qo.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: O ira na lewenivanua e Cuba era curu e Merika ena green card mera na rai vei ratou na tabana ni Curuvanua mai Ecuador mera vagalalataki mai na ivakatagedegede qo.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Me rauta ni sivia e 6 na vula mai na tikinisiga o lokuca tu ena nomu gade na kena rawa ni vakayagataki tiko ga na nomu pasipote. Ena vinakati e dua na tikite ni nomu gade e vanua taucoko/tomani ni ilakolako me rawa ni vakadeitaki na balavu ni nomu tiko.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Kevaka o lako duadua mai e vinaka mo vaqara mo lewena e dua na ilawalawa le va se ono mo dou gade vata ni na sau vinaka sara qori, ni rawa ni lutu sobu na isau ni tamata yadua.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Ia, mo kua ni leqataka soti qori ni o ira na vulagi era na dau sagai mera vakatawana na lori kece e veiusa.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: E vaka me dua na ilawaki mera lai vakabauta wale ga kina na tamata ni na vinakati mera sauma e levu na ilavo.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ena vualiku ni vanua o Machu Picchu e tu kina e dua na ulunivanua cere qai baba dodonu cake, o na dau raica ena levu na itaba kei na yavu ni koro makawa.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: E baba qiqo qai ririkotaki ni o tu yani e ra, sa bau dodonu dina qai dredre na cabeta, vei ira na bulabua qai kauakaua ena tauri ira ga 45 na miniti mera yaco icake.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: E levu na kena gaunisala e vakaikabakaba vatu, ia ena vanua dredre sa tu kina na kaukamea meda kukube kina.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Mo namaka tale tiko ga ni na oti koso nomu icegu, qarauna na vanua qiqo vakauasivi ke suasua, ena rawa ni totolo sara kena veisau me lai rerevaki.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: E toka sara e cake e dua na qara lailai mo na lako curuma, o na rairai vakatabui cegu mo curu rawa.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Mo rawa ni sarava vinaka na vanua kei na veika bula ena Galapagos, ena vinaka mo vodo waqa me vakataki Charles Darwin ga ena 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: E sivia ni 60 na waqa ni saravanua era muria na uciwai na Galapagos - mai na le 8 kina 100 na pasidia.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: E levu sara dau sauma rawa tu vakailiu na nodra dabedabe waqa (ni sa dau tawani kece na dabedabe na waqa donuya na gauna era gade yani kina e levu).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Mo nanuma tiko mo digitaka na kabani ni veivakasarasarataki e sa buta vinaka ena veivakasarasarataki ena Galapagos qai kila vinaka na duiduii waqa e veikau.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Mo na rawa ni vodo sara ga ena waqa ena vakayacora na veika o namaka kei na balavu ni gauna o via gade kina.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Ni bera nira yaco mai na kai Sipeni ena ika16 ni senitiuri, era dau liutaka tu na Inca na vualiku kei Chile ra qai tawana loma kei na ceva kei Chile na itaukei na Araucanians (Mapuche).
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: O ira na Mapuche era iotioti tale ga ni iawalawa itaukei kei Merika, era sega ni muria ra na lawa ni vosa vakaSipeni me yacova ni sa tu vakataki koya na Matanitu o Chille.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: E macala ni mai tu vakataki koya na vanua o Chille ena 1810 (donuya na nona mai ravuravu o Napolioni a sega tu ni dua na matanitu e qaravi Sipeni me vica na yabaki), na nodra qaqa vei ira na Sipeni a qai rawati sara ena 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Na Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) e dua na matanitu mai na Keribia ka tiko ena babatokalau ni yanuyanu o Isepaniolo, ka rau wasea vata kei Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Me kuria ga na kena veinuku vula kei na veiulunivanua e kilai tu kina, na vanua qo e a tara tu kina na imatai ni siti makawa duadua e Irope ena vanua o Amerika, ka sa mai wili tu qo i Santo Dominiko.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Era itaukei ni vanua o ira na kai Taino kei na Karibe. O ira na Karibe era kawa ni kai Arawakana ka ra a udu mai ena yabaki 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ni oti ga e vica na yabaki ni nodra udu mai na vaqara vanua mai Irope, era musuka sobu vakatotolo na kedra iwiliwili na lewenivanua mai Tainos o ira na dauvakayayanavanua qo ni Sipeni.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Ena nona ivakamacala o Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) ena loma ni yabaki 1492 kei na 1498 era ya vakamatea e 100,000 na kai Taino o ira na dauvakayayanavanua ni Sipeni.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Na vanua qo a tara ena ika 17 ni senitiuri me vale lomalevu tabavica e nodra itikotiko na dawai tabu ni lotu katolika, na vale ga sa qai vo tiko na Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: E sa vanua dau gadivi vakalevu ena gauna qo qai levu na ka era dau caka tu kina ena siga kei na bogi.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: E vica na valenikana e wavokita tu na loga seikau se vanua ni gade, ena yakavi era dau mai vakatagi eso na matasere e dau vakayacori qori ena dua na vale ena lomadonu ni vanua ni sarasara.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (iTatakoso ni Regu). E rau vanua ni vakacagicagi ena dua na fuloa ni vale e cake, na kedrau veiyawaki ga e 69 na sedimita, na vanua qori e nodra isotasota e rua erau veidomoni ni gauna makawa.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ena vica ga na silini era na rawa ni talanoataka vei iko na kena italanoa e vica na gone.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: E dua na vanua vinaka ni gade na yanuyanu o Bowen, era tu kina na velovelo lalai, rawa ni caka kina na taubale takoso e lomanivanua, tu kina sitoa ni volivoli, valenikana kei na levu tale.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Na itikotiko totoka qo e toka How Sound siviti Vancouver ga vakalailai, e rawa ni o gole kina na idinicavu e biubiu mai na yanuyanu o Granville ena taoni o Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Vei ira na taleitaka na taubale se sarava na vanua, o rawa ni muria na gaunisala ni taubale cake mai na Waitui ina Veidelana.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: O Whistler (1.5 na aua mai Vancouver) e vanua saulevu, ia e kilai tani ni vanua e vakayacori kina na Winter Olympic ni 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: O rawa ni marautaka ena vulaibatabata na lai vakatasisi ena uca cevata e Noca Merika, ena vulaikatakata o rawa ni marautaka na vodo basikeli e loma ni vanua.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Me na kerei rawa tu vakailu na ivolatara ni tiko. Ena vinakati me tiko dua na nomu ivolatara mo rawa ni moce i Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: O Sirena e itikotiko duadua e kina na ivakatawa ni veikau e vakarautaki kina na rumu ni moce kei na kakana butakataka me ikuri ni nomu lai keba. Na vanua o La Leona, San Pedrillo, kei Los Patos e sega ni vakarautaki kina na kakana, e caka ga kina na keba.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: E rawa ni o kauta mai na nomu ivolanitara ni tiko mai na Siteseni ni iVakatawa ni Veikau e Puerto Jiménez, ia e sega ni o rawa ni sauma ena credit card.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Na Park Service (MINAE) sega ni dau vakarautaka rau tu vakailiu na ivolatara ni tiko me vo e dua na vula vei ira na gade mai.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Na CafeNet El Sol e vakarautaka na veiqaravi me taura rawa tu na ivolatara ni tikinisiga o na gade kina ia na kena isau e $30, se $10 na ilavo ni Merika vei ira na gade ga ena dua na siga; e tu ena nodratou tabana ena veilawa na Corcovado na kena itukutuku matailalai.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Na Yatu kuka e tiko e Polinisia, ena loma donu ni Wasa Pasifika, qo e dua na yanuyanu e dau veimaliwai wale kei Niusiladi.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: E talawasewase na vanua qai 15 na yatu yanuyanu e tu veiyawaki e kovuta e 2.2 na milioni na kilomita2 na wasawasa.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ni tautauvata ga na kena gauna kei Hawaii, e dau nanumi tu na vanua qo me “Hawaii down under”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: E lailai toka ga, ia era dau lai nanuma kina na itabaqase ni vakataki Hawaii ni bera ni tu galala kina, qai se bera sara ni se tara na otela lelevu kei na veivakatorocaketaki tale eso.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: E sega ni dua na siti ena Yatu Kuka ia e tiko ga kina e 15 na yanuyanu. E rua ga dau lakovi vakalevu o Raratonga kei Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Sa bau duatani sara na kalasi ni vakarautaki ni katalau ena veivanua sa vakatorocaketaki.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kena vinaka duadua. E dau veisivisivi sara na B&B ena rua na ka: vanua ni moce kei na katalau.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ena veivanua e bau torocake toka e rawa ni raica kina e dua na loga saulevu, rairai e dua na iubi e cula ena liga se dua na mataqali loga ena gauna makawa.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Na katalau e rawa ni okati kina na kakana e kilai ena yasayasa oya se na vakarautaka ga o koya e veivakaicilitaki.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Ena rairai dua na vale e taravaki ena gauna makawa, vakaiyaya ni gauna e liu, savasava vinaka na kena lomanibai qai tu kina e dua na tobu ni sisili.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ni o vodo ga ena nomu motoka mo draiva vakabalavu e vakavu marau dina ni rawarawa sara.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: O sa na rairai kila vinaka sara na nomu draivataka nomu lori kei na veika e rawa ni cakava, ni vakauvatani kei na lori lelevu.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Na nomu keba ena dua na lomanibai e taukeni se dua ga na taoni e tiko eso na ka e rawa ni yaco.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Vakalekaleka sara, e gaunisala vinaka dina ni gade na nomu lori, ia e sega ni gaunisala vinaka ni “keba”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Na mataqali lori vinaka na keba e dua na minivan balavu, SUV na Sedan se Station Wagon e davo na kena idabebabe.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Eso na otela era maoroya tu na gaunisala ni sitima ni gauna makawa kei na waqa makawa; ni bera na iKarua ni Valu Levu, ena ika 19 ni senitiuri se itekiteivu ni ika 20 ni senitiuri.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Na veiotela qo e dau nodra vanua ni vakaicilii na vetaicake kei na tamata rogo, e vakasakiti na kena valenikana kei na veiporokaramu ena bogi.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: E kilai ena kena iyaya ni vale makawa, kena sega ni vakavoutaki tale ga vale ni vakacegu ni gauna makawa qai rairai makawa na vale.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: E macala ni tiko na kedra itaukei, era dau vakaicili kina ena so na gauna na iliuliu ni vanua kei na so tale na vakailesilesi lelevu ni matanitu.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: E dua beka na tamata vakailavo e rawa ni vakasamataka me gade e veiyasai vuravura, oti me qai tiko ena vica na siga ena levu na otela qo.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: E dua na isoqosoqo ni veikidavaki e dau semai ira na gade mai kei ira na lewenivanua ena siti era gade kina.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Ena vinakati me vakaleweni ga e dua na fomu ena veilawa mo lewena na isoqosoqo qori; eso tale isoqsoqo va qori era na rairai gadreva eso tale na ivakadinadina.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Sa qai dau taba ena pepe/biu veilawa e dua na lisi ni veivanua eso era rawa ni veivakaicilitaki, qai tu tale ga kina nodra ivakamacala o ira na sa gade oti kina.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: A tayavutaka e dua na dau buli porokaramu ni kompiuta o Casey Fenton na Couchsurfing ena Janueri ni 2004 qori baleta ni a sauma e dua na tikite ni waqavuka sau rawarawa i Iceland qai sega ni raica rawa e dua na vanua me vakaicili kina.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: A mani imelitaki ira eso na gonevuli ena dua na univesiti ena vanua ya, ra marau mera solia wale nodra rumu me lai vakaicili kina.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Era dau vakaicili vakalevu ena Hostel na itabagone - dua na vulagi e yabaki ruasagavulu vakacaca - o rawa ni raici ira tale ga kina na uabula era dau gade wavoki.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: E tutu yadua mera gole yani na gone kei na vuvale, eso na hostle era dau biuti ira ena dua na rumu.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Na korolevu o Beijing mai China ena veiqaravi tiko ena Qitio ni Vula i Batabata ni Olympic ena 2022, sa na lai imatai kina ni siti me itaukei ni soqo ni qito ena vula i katakata kei na vula i batabata ni Olympic
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Eratou na dolava na qito ratou qai sogota tale ga o Beijing na qito qai caka toka e loma ni dua na vale levu eso na qito ni vakatasisisi ena aisi.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ena vakayacori eso tale na qito ni vakatasisisi ena yasayasa o Taizicheng ski e Zhangjiakou, rauta ni 220 na kilomita (140 na maile) mai Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: E levua na vanua ni sokalou e dau vakayacori e veiyabaki e dua na nodra soqo me tekivu mai na icavacava ni Noveba ina Maliwa ni Vula o Me, ena dau vakatau ena nodra dui ivola ni vulaniyabaki na vanua ni sokalou qori.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: E levu na soqo ni vanua ni sokalou qori e dau solevutaki kena na gauna e tauyavu kina se nodra siganisucu na nodra kalou se dua tale na siga bibi e vauca na nodra vanua ni sokalou.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Na solevu ni vale ni sokalou nei Kerala o na matalau ni raica, nodra tayabe mai na elefaniti ukutaki vinaka, na kena matasere kei na so tale solevu.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: A World’s Fair (kilai tale ga me World Exposition, se Expo) e dua na soqo levu era na tiko kina e levu e veiyasai vuravura mera vakaraitaka kina nodra icakacaka ni liga maqosa kei na veika vakasaenisi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Ena tu na nodra dui vanua na matanitu era vakaitavi era na vakaraitaka na nodra icakacaka ni liga maqosa kei na so na ka ni vuli mera vakaraitaka kina na veika e tarai vuravura tiko se nodra itovo vakavanua se veika era kilai kina.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Na International Horticultural Exposition e dua na soqo e vakarautaki vakatabakidua me mai vakaraitaki kina na tuva ni senikau, veimataqali senikau ena dua na were totoka kei na veika tale eso e vauca na dui itei.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Kevaka vakasamataki e rawa ni caka e veiyabaki (kevaka vakayacori ena duidui vanua e vuravura), kena cakacakataki na vakasama qo ena dredre toka.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Na soqo qori e dau yaco ena tolu kina ono na vula na kena balavu, na vanua tale ga e vakayacori kina e rawa ni lailai mai na 50 na mita.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ena veiyabaki sa veiveisau na gaunisala ni veitaba. Kena ivakarau e 35 na milimita dua na balavu ni dua na icibini (36 ki na 24 na milimita na icibini taba) e dua na ivakarau e vakayagataki vakalevu.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: E dau rawarawa ni veisautaki ke sa oti koso, na irairai ni itaba e via tautauvata ga kei na dua na itaba ni gauna qo na DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Eso na itaba vinaka tale ga era vakayagataka na ivakarau ni itaba me 6 vakalevutaki ina 6 na sedimita, kena e donu vinaka sar ame 56 vakalevutaki ina 56 na sedimita na icibini taba.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Na kena ramase e raw ani vakavataka na itaba e 35 na milimita na kena icibini (3136 na milimita2 ni vakatauvatani kei na 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Na nodra tabaki na veikabula e dua dina na ka ni sasaga qai veivakaocai vei ira na veitaba, me rau lako vata na donu ni madigi, vosovoso, me sa dede nomu cakacaka voli kina, me vinaka tale ga nomu iyaya ni cakacaka.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: E dau raici tu ga vakamamada na nodra taba na veika bula, ia me vaka ga na vo ni itaba, e dua na itaba e rawa ni vakamacalataki ena levu na sala.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Na nodra taba na veikabula ena vinakati kina e dua na itaba balavu e rawa ni raica na ka e tu mai vakayawa, ena duatani ga na itaba era tabaki kina na manumanu lalai kei na manumanu somidi.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: E dau kunekunei dredre eso na manumanu kila qai dau tu eso na lawa e vauca na veitaba e lai bisinisitaki.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Era na rairai madua na manumanu kila se cudrucudru. Era na rairai katakata, sega ni taleitaki keda se ra cudrucudru.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: E 5,000 na duidui vosa e vuravura, wili kina e ruasagavulu e tiko kina e 50 na milioni se sivia na tamata era vosataka na kena vosa.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Na vosa tale ga e volai e rawarawa sara ni kilai mai na kena e cavuti. Qori me vaka na yaca ni itikotiko, e dau dredre toka me cavuti.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: E levu na vanua era sa taladrodro ena vosa vakavalgi, o rawa tale ga ni namaka me so era kila toka vakalailai - vakabibi vei ira na itabagone.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Vakasamataka mada, ke rawa, e dua mai Mancunia, Jamaica kei na dua mai Serene era dabe wavokita toka e dua na teveli ni kana mai Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Era dui talanoataka tiko eso na italanoa ni nodra vanua, ena nodra vosa ni sucu se ivakarau ni vosavosa.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: E sau rawarawa cake mo volia ga na kemu na sitoa. Ia ena dredre toka ke sega ni vakarautaki na vanua ni vakasaqa, qori o sa na qai lai tini volia ga kina na kakana buta kina.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: E levu na sitoa ena gauna qo sa ra volitaka na kakana sa vakarautaki rawa tu. Eso era rawa ni vakatakata ga ena ovani se microwave.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: E tiko ena so na vanua kei na so na mataqali sitoa e dua na valenikana e sega sara ni ka levu qai sau rawarawa na veika e vakarautaki kina..
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: O rawa ni tabaka toka e vica na ilavelave ni veika me baleta nomu inisua kei na gaunisala ni veitaratara kei na nomu kabani ni inisua.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: E dodonu me ratou vakarautaka na imeli kei na naba ni talevoni ni veitaratara mai vanuatani mo rawa ni taro ivakasal kina/kena dodonu me vakadonui/tarogi na veika me vakasukai lesu vei iko.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Me dua tale na ilavelave o maroya ena nomu kato se ena veilawa (vakabira na ivola ni o imelitaka vei iko, se maroroya ina “cloud”)
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ni o veitosoyaki voli ena nomu laptop se tablet, maroya kina e dua na kena ilavelave (o rawa ni rai kina ke o sega ni sema rawa ina veilawa).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: O rawa ni solia tale ga e dua na ilavelave ni veika vauca nomu inisua kei na sala ni veitaratara ina kabani vei ira nomu itokani se wekamu ena nomu vanua se o ira dou lako vata.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Na Moose (kilai tale ga me elk) era sega ni manumanu cudrucudru, ia ena rawa ni vala me taqomaki koya kina.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Nira nanuma eso ni rairai manoa tu ga na moose era rawa ni lako vakavoleka sara ena dua na vanua e rerevaki sara.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Me vakarauta ga na alakaolo o gunuva. Mo kila tale ga na nomu iyalayala ni duidui na kena cakacaka ena yago na alakaolo.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Na leqa e rawa ni yaco ena kena gunuvi vakalevu na alakaolo e rawa ni okati kina na vakaleqai ni liva, e rawa ni vakavuna na mataboko kei na mate. Sa na qai vakarawarawataka ga na kena yaco na leqa qori ni gunuvi na alakaolo e vakatabui.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: E levu na wainimate rerevaki e tiko ena veimataqali siviriti vakatabui me vaka na methanol, ke gunuvi mada ga vakalailai e rawa ni vakavuna na mataboko se mata mada ga.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Na matailoilo e rawa ni au rawarawa sara ena veivanua vulagi, vakabibi ena veimatanitu era sega ni rawaka vakalevu ra qai sau lailai na tamata cakacaka.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Tovolea me dikevi ga e vale na matamu, vakabibi ke okati tiko ena nomu inisua, qai dau kauta tiko na ivakamacala ni veika e vauca na matamu ena vanua o gade kina.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: E rawa ni rua na leqa e kune ena matailoilo kilai e tiko ena vanua va qori; eso era rawa ni ka e lasutaki, kei na kena ka dina e vakau mai ena rairai saulevu sara mai na vanua o tiko kina.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Na Kofi e dua vei ira na kakana e dau vakayagataki ena veisau ivoli e veiyasai vuravura, o rawa ni raica e vica na mataqali ena nomu vanua.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Ia se mani cava, e duidui na sala e dau vakayagataki kina na kofi ena veiyasai vuravura mo tovolea mada.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Na vosa vaka Peretania na Canyoning (se: canyonerring) e baleta tiko na nomu lako ena ruku ni veiqakilo ni veidelana, e rawa ni mamaca se suasua.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Na Canyoning e okati kina na veka me vaka na qalo, kaba ena veidelana se lade--ena sega ni gadrevi mo tereni sara se bulicaki vinaka na yagomu mo rawa ni vakaitavi (sega ni vaka na nomu kabata ena veivatu, lai nunu se vakatasisi ena ucacevata, me kena ivakaraitaki).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Na taubale e dua na ka e dau vakayacori vakalevu e tautuba, e okati kina na nomu taubale ena veikau ni vakamuri na gaunisala sa ta rawa tu.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Na taubale ena siga na kena balavu e lailai mai na dua na maile se balavu sara me lai dua na siga taucoko.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kevaka dua e bulabula vinaka ena rawa ni marautaka me taubale ena dua na siga ke vanua lekaleka mada ga, ia ena vinakati na vakavakarau vinaka.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: O ira na vakavuvale se vakaluveni ena vinakati e levu na gauna mera vakavakarau kina, ia e rawa ni dou gade e tautuba kei ira na luvemu, se ra mani peipei se ra muri vuli.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: E voleka ni 200 isoqosoqo ni veitaucici e veiyasai vuravura. E levu era dui cicivaka ga na nodra.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Na isoqosoqo e mai sosomitaka na Global Running Tou na Go Running Tours e dau veivosakitaki e vica vata na drau na vanua ni veitaucicici kei na sarasara ena va na yasana ena noda vuravura.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ni tu na nona isema ni veikilai ena tabana ni veitaucici na Barcelona's Running Tours kei na kena mai Copenhagen na Copenhagen's Running, e totolo tale ga na nodratou sema kina na Running Tours Prague mai Prague kei na so tale.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: E levu na ka mo na vakasamataka ni bera ni gade kei na gauna sa gade kina ena dau na vanua.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ni o gade mo na namaka tiko ni levu na ka o na vulagi kina e sega ni vaka “mai nomu vanua”. Na itovo, lawa, kakana, sala ni veitosoyaki, icili, ivakatagedege ni bula, vosa kei na so tale ena duatani.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: E dua na ka mo na vakasamataka tiko, mo kua ni cata se sevaka na ivakarau e vakayacori kina na ka ena vanua o tiko kina.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: O ira na tuvanaka na veitosoyaki se ra tekivu sara mai na ika19 ni senitiuri. E vakasama vinaka mo veivosakitaka rawa na nomu igolegole kei na dua na tabana era dau tuvanaka na gade, vakabibi ena vanua e vou vua e dua, ivakarau ni itovo, se vanua e se qai vakatorocaketaki tiko.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: E macala ni levu na tabana era dau tuvanaka na ilakolako e rawa ni vakarautaka na ilakolako cava ga era kerei kina, ia e levu era kenadau ena so na mataqali gade, levu ni ilavo e nanumi me vakayagataki se ilakolako.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Ena vinaka sara mo vakayagataka e dua na tabana e tuvanaka na ilakolako e via tautauvata kei na kena o dau vakayagataka.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Mo raica rawa na mataqali gade vakacava e volitaka tiko, ena nona website se ena iloilo ni nona sitoa.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: E tiko na sala o rawa ni raica kina na vuravura ena sala e ivakarau ni bula e rawarawa, kena e vakayacora sara ga na veika o gadreva, se vakatovolea eso na ka vou.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: E rawa ni rua na sala e caka kina qori: Dua ni o cakacaka sara ga ena gauna o gade tiko kina se tovolea mo vakalailaitaka na ka mo sauma. Na ulutaga qo ena veivosakitaka na veika o rawa ni cakava.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Vei ira na bolea mera biuta vakatikitiki na bula vakacegu, sega ni leqataka na gauna kei na nodra saga me lutu sobu sara ga ena saiva na nodra sausaumi, rai ena gade ni minimum budget.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Na ivakasala sa kilai tiko kina ni o ira na gade era na sega ni butako, takoso vakaveitalia, vakaitavi ena basulawa, kerekere, se lawakitaki ira tale eso mera rawaka kina.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Na checkpoint ni vakailesilesi ni curuvanua e dau imatai ni vanua o curuma ni o sobu mai ena dua na waqavuka, waqa motoka.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ena so na tereni e takosova na iyala ni so na vanua, ena dau caka na veidikevi ena loma ni tereni qai vinakati mo kauta tiko e dua nomu ID ni o vodo tiko ena dua vei ira na tereni qori.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Ena tereni ena ilakolako balavu era bogi dua kina eso era na rairai taura na vakailesilesi ni tereni na nomu pasipote mera kina ni vakasosani iko ena gauna o moce tu kina.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: E dua tale na ituvatuva e vinakati ena visa na rejisita. Ena so na vanua, ena vinakati mo na rejisitataka na vanua o tiko kina vei ira na vakailesilesi ni matanitu.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Ena rairai vinakati kina mo vakalewena e dua na fomu vei ratou na ovisa se mo sikova na nodratou valenivolavola na vakailesilesi ni curuvanua.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Ena levu na vanua e vakalawataki mo cakava qori, na otela o lai vakaicili kina ena rawa ni rejisitataki iko (mo taroga rawa).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Ena so tale na ituvaki, era na dau rejisita ga o ira era vakaicili ena taudaku ni vanua era vakaicili kina na saravanua. Ia e sa lai vakaverevereataka sara na lawa, mo na taroga rawa tu na ka kece qori.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: E kauaitaka e dua na daudroini peleni na kena droinitaki kei na kena taravaki e dua na vale. E rawa nira vanua ni sarasara vei ira na saravanua na itaratara ni dua na vale.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: E levu e rairai vinaka nida sarava, na nomu sarava na vanua mai na dua na vale balavu, se katubaleka e biu tu vakamaqosa ena dua na vanua e rawa ni vakatubuqoroqoro nida raica.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Na itaivi ni daudroini peleni e lakolako vata kei na so tale na mataqali cakacaka, okati kina na pelenitaki ni taoni, cakacaka vakaidinia, ukutaki ni iyaya kei na vale kei na bulicaki ni vanua.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: E macala ni yawa sara na vanua era tu kina na pueblo, ia o na sega ni raica e dua na vanua ikeri e vakayacori kina na soqo ena bogi, vakavo sara ke o gole i Albuquerque se Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Ia voleka ni casino kece e volai mai cake era vakarautaka na gunu, qai vica vei ira e vakayacani na nodra ka ni veivakamarautaki (qo o ira na vanua lelevu e wavokita na vanua o Albuquerque kei Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Qarauna: na vanua ni gunu ena veitaoni lalai e sega ni vanua vinaka mera lai gunu kina na vulagi.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: E dua na iwase levu ena vualiku kei New Mexico era dau draiva nira mateni, ena veitaoni lalai e levu sara na ivakarau ni gunu e laurai vei ira na draiva.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Na tositosi kei na volavolai ni dua na vanua era okati mera graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: E macala ni sega ni rawa ni okati me dua na ka ni gauna qo, e levu era dau sema na veika qori kei na nodra dau volavola na lalaga kei na nodra itikotiko eso tale na itabagone nira vakayagataka na iboro spray.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Ia ena gauna qo sa tiko o ira na rogo ena buturara ni droini, e dau caka na soqo ni graffiti kei na vola ni lalaga e “vakadonui vakalawa”. Na iboro ni graffiti ena ituvaki qo e vakaibalebaleta ka na droini se yaloyalo se ni dua na ga na ivakatakilakila ni basulawa.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Na viritaki ni Boomerang e dua na ivakarau ni kila era via vuilca e levu na saravanua.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ke o via vulica na viritaki ni boomerang me lesu tale mai ligamu, mo nanuma me tiko e dua na nomu boomerang veiganiti ena rawa ni lesu tale mai.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: E levu na boomerang e volitaki tu e Ositerelia era sega ni rawa ni lai veisautaki tale. E vinaka mera kua ni viritaka ena vanua cagicagi o ira na se qai tekviu.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Na Hangi e dua na ivakarau ni vakasaqa e caka ena dela ni qele.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Ena dau tavuni ena lovo na vatu, se ena so na vanua sa katakata rawa tu na ruku ni qele.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: E dau caka na hangi me tavu kina na kakana me vakayakavi.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Ena so na vanua e Rotorua e tu kina na hangi e caka ena dela ni qele katakata, ia e dua tale na ivakarau ni hangi e caka mai Christchurch, Wellington kei na so tale na vanua.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: E rua tiko na iwase ni tereni ena MetroRail vei ira na lewenivanua e loma kei na veivanua wavolita na Cape Town: MetroPlus (e vakatokai tale ga na First Class) kei na Metro (vakatokai na Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: O na marautaka cake na vodo ena MetroPlus qai sega ni levu era vodo kina qai saulevu, ia e se sau lailia tiko ni vakatauvatani kei na so na tikite ni tereni e Urope.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Na tereni kece e tiko kina na MetroPlus kei na Metro coach; na MetroPlus coach e dau tu voli ga ena mua ni kelekele ni tereni voleka i Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Na nodra kauaitaki eso tale - Mo kua ni biuta tu nomu beki mo lako, vakabibi ni o takosova tiko e dua tale na iyala ni vanua.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: E rawa ni o vakayagataki mo usana eso na wainimate gaga o sega tu ni kila, e rawa ni o lai tini leqa tale kina.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Qo e okati kina na nomu wawa tu ena laini nira lako mai na koli mera boica na wainimate gaga, o sega tu ni kila.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ena so na matanitu e dau kaukaua sara na itotogi e tau vei ira mada ga na se qai cala vakadua; e rawa ni okati kina na nomu bala e valeniveivesu me sivia e 10 na yabaki se o vakamatei sara ga.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Na biu vakaca ni beki e nodra takete na butako e rawa nira lai okata tale ga na vakailesilesi me gasaukuro.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ena nomu vanua ni sa rairai matau na yagomu ena manumanu midimidi se duka.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ia ena so tale na yasa ni vuravura, ke vou vei iko na manumanu midimidi se bacteriological fauna ena rawa ni vakatauvimatetaki iko.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Ena veivanua katakata tale ga era na tete totolo kina qai bula balavu ena taudaku ni yago.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: O koya gona na Delhi Belly, na Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, e vica na nodra itokani.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Vaka kina e dau yaco vakalevu na leka ni cegu ena vanua batabata, mate ni kete ena vanua katakata, era dau vakaninivaki dina ia e sega ni leqataki sara.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ke o se lako vakadua ena dua na vanua se qai vakatorocaketaki iko - se dua tale na vanua e yasai vuravura - mo namaka tiko ni vou vei iko e levu na ka.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: E levu era sa matau na gade e sa lai muloci tale ena levu na ka vou ena veivanua se qai vakatorocaketaki tiko, e rawa ni levu tale na ka e vinakati mo na veisautaka ena vuku ni ivakarau vakavanua.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Ena gauna o se qai yaco ga yani kina, tovolea mo volia na iyaya ena vanua ya, lako ena otela vinaka, tovolea na kena kakana, kei na veiqaravi tale eso mo rawa ni vakamatauni iko kina.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kua ni moce ena meteresi se davo ena fuloa ke o sega ni kila na manumanu midimidi lalai era tu ena vanua qori.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Kevaka o na lai keba ena dua na vanua, kauta tiko e dua na idavodavo lobi se hammock mo galala mai na gata, batibasaga kei na so tale.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Me teteva ena nomu vale na iboi ni kofi sosoko ena mataka kei na veivakacegui ni ti na chamomile ena bogi.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Kevaka o gade voli ga ena nomu vanua, sa na tiko na gauna mo rawa ni marautaka kina eso na gunu o na taleitaka.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ke o via cakava tale eso na ka, tovolea mo blend taka ga na memu gunu se so na veimataqali vuata:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: o na rawa ni kila beka e dua na gunu rawarawa ga o rawa ni vakarautaka mo katalau kina ni o sa tomana tale na nomu cakacaka ni veisiga.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ke o tiko ena siti e levu tu na mataqali ka o rawa ni gunuva, gole ena dua na vanua ni gunu se bar o sega ni dau goleva wasoma.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Ena so na vosa e sega ni matata vakavuniwai, na vosa infectious kei na contagious e duidui ena kedrau ibalebale.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Na mate e infectious e mataqlai mate e vu mai na dua na pathoge, me vaka na virus, bacterium, fungus kei na so tale na manumanu midimidi.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Na mate e contagious e dua na mataqali mate e rarawa sara ni veidewavi ke o tiko volekata e dua e tauvimate.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: E levu na matanitu era na vinakata vei ira na vulagi yani se vei ira na lewenivanua tudei era biubiu ina dua tale vanua mera cula rawa ena veimataqali mate.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Na veika qori ena vakatau ena vanua sa gade oti kina e dua, sa lesuva mai se via lai butuka.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Dua na tikina e vinaka kina o Charlote, mai na Vualiku kei Carolina, oya ni levu na ka e dau vakarautaki kina vei ira na vuvale
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: O ira na vakaitikotiko mai na so tale na vanua era tukuna ni dua ni vuna era tiko kina ekea ni vanua vinaka me tiko kina na vuvale, ira na vulagi era kaya nira marautaka na lako kei ira na luvedra ki taoni.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Ena 20 na yabaki sa oti, e levu sara na vanua e Uptown Charlotte e vakarautaki me ganiti ira tale ga na gone.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Era sega ni dau vakayagataka vakalevu na taxi o ira na veimatavuvale e Charlotte, era na qai dau vakayagataka ga ena so na ituvaki.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kevaka sa sivia e 2 na pasidia e vodo ena toso cake na ivodovodo, ena via saulevu toka qori.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Na Antarctica e vanua batabata duadua e Vuravura, ka wavolita na Muana batabata ena Ceva.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: E sau levu, ni kena lei saravi se gadivi, ka gadrevi sara kina vakalevu na ituvaki vinaka ni yago, ka rawa ga ni vakayacori ena gauna ni vula katakata na Nove-Fepe, ka yalani ga kina icurucuru e waitui, Yanuyanu kei na Waitui na Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: E rauta ni udolu na tamata cakacaka era tiko ekea ena vulai katakata ka rauta ni va na daseni ni wasewase ena veivanua oqori; e dua na iwiliwili lailai era dau tiko ekea ena vulai batabata.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Ena loma ni vanua e Antarctica e dua na vanua tautauvata e ubia tu e 2-3 na km na waicevata.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Na vuka ni sarasara vakavudua e loma ni vanua, me baleti ira na dau cabe ulunivanua se me yaco yani ki na Muana batabata, e tiko kina e dua na itikotiko levu.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Na South Pole Traverse (se Gaunisala) e 1600 na kilomita mai na Siteseni o McMurdo ena Waitui o Ross ina Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Na vavaku na ucacevata, vavaku qai vakatakilai ga ena kuila. E tiko ga na mataqali tractor me gole kina, e tiko na kena iqavi, e levu tale ga na kena waiwai kei na kakana.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Na vanua qo e sega ni rawarawa toka na takosova ni na balavu toka na kena cawiritaka na Ulunivanua na Transantarctic me qai ina veiyanuyanu lalai
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: E dau vu vakalevu na mavoa ena vulaibatabata ena sisi ni gaunisala, vanua ni taubale (e batinisala) vakabibi na ikabakaba.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ena vinakati mo daramaka na ivava e kaukaua na bukuna. Na ivava ni vula i katakata e dau sisisi sara vakalevu ena aisi kei na ucacevata, eso mada ga na boot ni vula i batabata e sega ni kaukauwa sara.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Na kena titobu me 5 na milimita (1/5 inch) se siva na kena titobu, me malumu vinaka tale ga na kena isulu ena draki batabata.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Eso na boot e vakabatina na bukuna se rawa ni coba kina ena vuku ni vanua sisisi, e ganita vinaka na ivava kei na boot, na ivava titeqe se bukuna.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Me kua ni cere sara na ivava titeqe ia me raba toka. Ena dau sova toka ena loma ni gaunisala na qereqere se masima (calcium chloride) me veivuke mo kua ni sisi.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: E dau wasoma na kena dau sisi na ucacevata mai na baba; ni dau levu na ucacevata ena veidelena ena dau sisi qai qeqera mai vaka e dua na polo.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: E leqa ni kabikabi na ucacevata, ena vinakati me yavalati me rawa ni lutu sobu mai, ni so gona na ucaceva e sisi mai e rawa ni vakavuna mera sisi tale ga na kena vo.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
