text: Ena so na gauna e dau vakavuna na sisi ni ucacevata ni vakawaicalataka na ucacevata na matanisiga, ena so tale ga gauna e sivia ga na ucacevata, so na gauna e sisi ni yaco e dua na leqa tubukoso, ia vakalevu era dau vakavuna ga na tamata.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: E kaukauwa sara na cagi maliwa ni covulaca, e dau domica cake gona i macawa na ka e toka e matana.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: E kaukauwa sara na cagi e kaburaka (vakalevu me 100/200 na maile ena dua na aua) qai rawa mada ga ni laveta e macawa na veika bibi, qai kauta kei koya ena gauna e toso kina.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: E vaka ga na irairai ni fanala ni se qai tekivu ni tekivu kumukumuni na o ni draki ca, qai vuki me “covulaca” ni tara na qele.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Na VPN (virtual private network) e dua na gaunisala vinaka me vakaraitaki kina na veika e tarova e dua na isoqosoqo vakapolitiki kei na Vei Kabani eso - ena rawa ni vakaraitaki ga ena so na vanua.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: E levu na vuna e uasivi cake sara mai na web proxy: E sega ga ni veisautaka na http, e veisautaka kece sara ga na gaunisala ni Internet.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: E totolo sara na kena toso na internet qai vinaka sara na kena veiqaravi. E vunitaki na gaunisala e muria qai dredre me dua e kila ni o tiko kina.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Era dau lasutaka na sala ni vakauitukutuku na kena inaki nira tukuna ni “tarova na kena volitaki vakailoa e dua na ka”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Na kena dina, na region code e sega ni rawa ni tarova na kena kopitaki vakailoa; ke kopitaki na veitikina kece ni disc se bit-for-bit ena rawa ni saravi ena dua na misini cava ga e saravi kina na kena original.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Na kena inaki ga me rawa nira lewa kina na kabani na nodra makete; me rawati vakalevu kina na ilavo.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Me vaka ni sa rawa ni sema ina Internet na qiri, sa sega ni gadrevi mo vakayagataka e dua na talevoni ni kabani ena vanua o tiko kina se vanua o lako kina.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: E sega ni gadrevi me tiko vei iko e dua na naba ni vanua o tiko kina, o rawa ni vakayagataka na internet ni setilaite ena loma ni vanua mai Chicken, Alaska qai digia e dua na naba me vakaraitaka ni o qiri tiko yani e Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: E vakalevu mo na dau volia e dua na naba me rawa kina ni sema yani kina na vei iko na qiri ni PSTN. Ia na naba o digia ena veivuke mera kila na isau ni qiri mera qiri yani kina vei iko.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Na Real-time text translator app e dua na porokaramu ni talevoni e rawa ni vakadewataka na vosa kece e taipataki mai na dua na vosa ina dua tale.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Eso mada ga na kena porokaramu e rawa ni vakadewataka ena yatuvosa se text na ibalebale ni ibulibuli ni dua na ka se na iyaya. Qori ena nona vagolea na itaba ni nona talevoni smartphone ina ka e vinakata me vakadewataki.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Sa vinaka sara na porokaramu ni vakadewa, e laurai ni rawa ni vakadewataka dodonu se cala na vosa (sega sara ni levu na vosa tawayaga), ia e gadrevi tiko ga na qaqarauni ena so na gauna, ni rairai se cala tiko eso na ka era cakava.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: E dua na app e dau vakayagataki vakalevu na Google Translate, ka vakatara vei ira na dauvakadewavosa ena taudaku ni initaneti ni sa lavetaki na itukutuku ni vosa e gadrevi.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Na GPS ena talevoni na smartphone e rawa ni gaunisala rawarawa duadua ni veitosoyaki ni o gole ena dua na vanua o vulagi kina.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: E rawa ni vakabula ilavo sara mai na nomu volia e dua na GPS vou, se redetaka e dua na kena misini mai na kabani ni rental o kauta mai kina na lori.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Kevaka o sega ni vaka data ena nomu talevoni se yawa mai na sikinala ni tawa ni talevoni, ena sega ni rawa ni cakacaka.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: E tiko ena veisitoa lalai kece e levu na mataqali kad saumi ni qiri e rawa ni vakayagataki me sauma nomu qiri ena talevoni.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: E macala ni rawa ni vakayagataki na kad mo qiri kina ena dua na vanua e veiyasai vuravura, ia eso e rawa ni vakalutuma na isau ni qiri ena so na matanitu.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Me rawa ni o qiri o na dau tabaka e dua na naba e sega ni saumi se toll-free, na naba qo e rawa ni vakayagataki mai na dua ga na talevoni.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Na lawa eso e vauca na veitaba e dau vakalevu me okati tale ga kina na katoni ni vidio ena talevoni.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Kevaka e sega ni vakadonui mo tabaka e dua na ka, mo kua ni nanuma sara ni o rawa ni lai katona ena vidio.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Kevaka o vakayagataka e dua na dron, mo dikeva rawa e liu na ka o rawa ni tabaka kei na veivakadonui se laiseni e gadrevi kina.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kevaka sega mada ga ni vakatabui ena nomu vanua, na nomu vukataka e dua na drone ena rara ni waqavuka se vanua era tu kina e levu e sega tu ga ni vakasama vinaka.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Ena gauna qo e sega ni levu era sauma ga vakadodonu ina kabani ni waqavuka na nodra tikite. Era dau vakatauvatana mada e liu na duidui isau ni so tale na waqavuka.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ena so na gauna e rawa ni duidui sara vakalevu na isau ni dua na vuka ke vakatauvatani kei na vo tale ni waqavuka era vuka kina, e yaga gona mo dikeva rawa na website ni so tale na kabani ni waqavuka ni bera ni o sauma nomu tikite.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: O na rairai gadreva e dua na visa ni veisiko lekaleka ena so na matanitu mo dua na saravanua se dua e lako vakabisinisi. Ia ni o gole ena vanua qori ni o dua na gonevuli ena vinakati mo na tiko tale vakadede mai na nomu lako ga vakagade.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Mo rawa ni tiko vakadede ena dua na vanua o vulagi kina ena vinakati me vakadonui rawa nomu visa.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: E duatani na visa ni gonevuli ni levu na ka ena vauci kina ni vakatauvatani kei na visa ni saravanua se lako vakabisinisi.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Ena levu na matanitu ena vinakati me dua rawa na ivola eratou vakarautaka na koronivuli o na lai vuli kina, mo vakaraitaka tale ga na ivakadinadina ni o rawa ni qaravi iko ga ena imatai ni yabaki ni nomu tiko.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Mo taroga na vanua ni vuli, wili kina o ratou na tabana ni curuvanua ni vanua o na gole kina ena itukutuku matailalai tale eso.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Vakavo sara ke o mata mai na dua tale na vanua, na nomu cakacaka ena dua tale na matanitu ena vinakati mo na vakalewena na nomu ivakacavacava ni veisaumi ena vanua o tiko kna.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: E duidui na ivakarau ni kena vakaleweni na ivakacavacava ni veisaumi ena dui matanitu, na ivakacavacava tale ga e dau musu e duidui.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Ena so na vnaua me vakataki Amerika kei Kenada, na ivakacavacava ni veisaumi e lavetaka ruarua na matanitu kei na vanua o tiko kina, qai rawa ni duidui ni vakatau ena vanua o tiko kina.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ena rairai sega ni levu sara na vakailesilesi ni curuvanua mera kidavaki iko ni o lesu tale ena nomu vanua, o rawa ni dau lai tao ga ena tabana ni kasitaba.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Mo na kila rawa tiko na veika o rawa ni kauta mai kei iyaya e vakatabui vakalawa ni o yaco mai qai nanuma mo vakaraitaka vakadodonu na ka e tiko ena nomu kato ena kad ni kasitaba e soli vei iko ni o vuka tiko mai.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Me tekivu nomu bisini ni nomu vakavola na vanua o lako kina ena vinakati mo na maqosataka rawa nomu volavola ena dua na website ni vakauitukutuku sa tiko rawa.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Ni o sa matai na veisautaka qai vakavinakataka na yatuvosa o biuta ena web, sa na rairai kalawa tarava me dua sara ga nomu website.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Na nomu bole vakataki iko mo gade e dua na sala vinaka mo vakayacora kina na veisau, ia e sega ni baleta nomu soli iko vakarawarawa.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Na nomu bole mo tiko qai veiqaravi ena dua tale na vanua e sala vinaka mo kila kina na duidui ivakarau vakavanua, sotavi ira na tamata vovou, vulica na veika e baleti iko, vukea na ivakarau ni nomu rai qai rawati tale ga kina eso na taledi vovou.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: E vinaka mo tiko tale mada ka rawa ni o dreta vakabalavu nomu ituvatuva vakailavo mo tiko ena dua na vanua me rawa ni ko cakacaka vakavolidia me vaka e dau vakarautaki kina na rumu ni tiko ka eso dau saumi talega.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: O ira na Viking era vakayagataka na icurucuru e wai ni matanitu o Rusia mera yaco ki na Black Sea kei Caspian Sea. E se rawa tiko ga ena gauna qo eso na itatakoso qori. Vakataroga rawa na kena rawati na ivolatara ni takoso, ena rairai dredre me rawati.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Na Kanala ni White Sea–Baltic e sema na Wasawasa na Arctic ina Baltic Sea ena Toba mai Onega, Toba o Ladoga kei Saint Petersburg, vakabibi ga ena uciwai kei na toba.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Na Toba o Onega e sema i Volga, koya gona e se rawa tiko ga ni o gole i Rusia mai na Caspian Sea.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Mo nuidei ni gauna o sa yaco kina ena ikelekele ni waqa, o na sotavi ira tale ga eso era dau vodo loto ena so na waqa era rawa ni wasea vei iko na veika era kila.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Me rawarawa sara, ko na biuta tiko na notisi me vakaraitaka na nomu veivuke, wavokita na wavu, lako yani vei ira na samaka tiko na iota, ka saga mo veitaratara kei ira na dausoko ena vanua ni gunu.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Mo saga mo veitalanoa kei ira e levu. Ni toso na gauna era na kilai iko qai vakaraitaka vei iko eso na waqa era vinakata tiko na veivuke.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Mo na digitaka vakamatau na nomu kabani ni waqavuka mo vuka kina ka biuta kina nomu Frequent Flyer.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: E dina beka ni ko na nanuma ni vinaka cake ga mo na lewena na kabani ni waqavuka ko dau vuka wasoma kina, ia dodonu mo kila ni eso na waqavuka e levu cake kina na poidi ni vuka ka rawa ni vinaka cake na poidi era solia na kabani ni waqavuka tale eso.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Na kabani ni waqavuka me vaka na Emirates, Eithad Airways, Qatar Airways kei na Turkish Airlines era sa vuka tale ga e Aferika, era sa vakarabailevutaka na nodra veiqaravi ki Aferika, ka vakarautaka tale ga na vuka veisemati ni ka vei korolelevu e Aferika ena isau lailai mai na kabani ni waqavuka e Iurope.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Me tekivu mai na 2014 na kabani ni waqavuka na Turkish Airlines sa vuka ina 39 na vanua ena 30 na matanitu e Aferika.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Kevaka e tiko nomu gauna, vakatauvatana mada na isau ni nomu vuka e Aferika kei na isau ni nomu vuka e veiyasai vuravura.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Kua ni guilecava mo okata tale ga na isau ni vakarautaki ni so tale na visa, ivakacavacava ni o biubiu, isau ni nomu veitosoyaki kei so tale, ena veivanua eso ena taudaku kei Aferika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Kevaka o via vuka wavoki e vuravura mo yaco sara ena Southern Hemisphere, e vakaiyalayala ga na vanua o rawa ni vuka kina ena vuku ni dredre ni gaunisala takoso e waitui.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: E sega ni dua na waqavuka me takosova kece na tolu na waswase ena Yasani Vuravura ena Vualiku (e sega tale ga ni kovuta e dua vei ira na itatakoso qori na SkyTeam).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Ia na Star Alliance e kovuta na ke kece vakavo ga ena tokalau ni Ceva ni Pasifika mai Santiago de Chile i Tahiti, e kilai toka me vuka na LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: E sega ni koya ga qori na waqavuka o rawa ni digitaka ke o sega ni via muria na gaunisala ina Ceva ni Pasifika kei na baravi ena ra kei na Ceva i Amerika. (rai e ra)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ena 1994, era veivaluvaluti na itaukei ni vanua mai na yasayasa o Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh kei Azerbaijan.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ena nodra veitokoni na kai Armenia, a tauyavu tale kina e dua na matanitu. Ia e saga ni dua na matanitu - se matanitu mada ga o Armenia - e raica me dua na matanitu dina.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Na veileti vakamatanitu ena vuku ni dui yasana se vakaleqa tiko na nodrau veimaliwai o Armenia kei Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Na Canal District (vakaDutch: Grachtengordel) e dua na yasana kilai ena ika17 ni senitiuri e wavolita na taoni o Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Na yasana taucoko qori e sa okai me UNESCO World Heritage Site ena vuku ni kena ivakarau vakavanua kei na itukutuku makawa. Na itikotiko era tu kina era sau levu duadua e vuravura.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Na vanua o Cinque Terre, e kena ibalebale na Lima na Vanua, e tiko kina e lima na kkoro ena baravi o Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza kei Monterosso e tiko ena yasana o Itali mai Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Era okati tale tiko ga ena UNESCO World Heritage List.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ena vica vata na senitiuri, era vakaivatavatataka na qele ena veibaba cere ni vanua qori me yaco sara ena ulunivanua e sarava tu yani na waitui.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Dua na vuna e totoka kna na vanua qori ni sega ni levu sara na veivakatorocaketaki e vakayacori. Me rawa ni dua yaco ena koro qori ena vinakati me vodo ga ena sitima ni vanua se vodo waqa. E sega ni rawa ni yaco kina na motoka.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Na vosa vakaVaranise e cavuti e Belgium kei Suwitisiladi e duidui ga vakalailia mai na vosa vakaVaranisi e cavuti e Varanise, e macala ni rau veiwekani veivolekati sara.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Vakauasivi, na ivakarau ni wiliwili ena vanua o Belgium era vosataka na vosa vakaVaranise kei Suwitisiladi e duidui ga vakalailai kei na vosa vakaVaranise e cavuti e Varanise. E duidui tale ga na icavucavuti ni so na vosa.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Sa mani cava o ira kece era Belgium kei Suwitisiladi era rairai vulica oti e koronivuli na vosa vakaVaranise dina, ena rawa ni kila gona ke o cavuta na iwiliwili ena vosa dina vakaVaranise.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Ni o yaloyalo vua e dua e dau kilai ena levu na vanua e vuravura mo vaka “bula.”
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Ia ena vanua o Malesia se vei ira ena veikorokoro o Malesia na nomu cakava qori e kena ibalebale ni o “sureti koya me lako yani,” qo e via tautauvata ga kei na nomu yalova mai e dua e ivakaraitaki ni nomu sureti koya. Me nanumi tiko ni dodonu me caka ga ena inaki yani.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ke dua gona e kai Peritania e gole i Sipeni e rawa ni vakacala e dua ni o yaloyalo vua (mai na nomu yalovi koya ni sa lako) o nanuma ni lako, sa o sureti koya tale yani vei iko.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: E dau vakayagataki na vosa buli se vosa vulagi vei ira na sega ni veikilai vosa mera rawa ni veivosaki kina.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: E duidui sara mai na lingua fancas, na vosa sa mai vakayagataki raraba mera rawa nira veitaratara kina o ira mai na duidui vosa.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Ena dua na siga katakata e rawa ni raica e dua na iyalyalo ni dua na tobu wai (se so tale na ka).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ena rawa ni vakarerevaki ke goleva o kaya na ka e raica qori ia e sega ni dina, ni na rawa ni lusi kina na nona icegu qai maca tale kina na mena wai se bau vo toka.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Na vanua dravuisiga katakata mada ga e rawa ni batabata sara ena bogi. Kevaka e sega na isulu katakata e rawa ni o qonini ena batabata.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ena vulaikatakata, ena vinakati mo qarauna na namu ke o via taubale ena veikau.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Kevaka o draiva mada ga ena loma ni veikau ena dua na vanua katakata, ke vica mada ga na sekodi nomu dolava na katuba sara na curu totolo kina na namu.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Na mate ni manumanu vukavuka, se kilai tale ga me avian influenza, e rawa ni vakaleqai ira na manumanu vuka kei na manumanu vakatokai me mammals.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: E sega ni levu sara na kisi e tarai ira na tamata, ia eso vei ira sa lai veivakamatei sara.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: E dewavi ira vakalevu na cakacaka ena bai ni vuaka, e ririkotaki tale ga ni rawa ni dewavi ira tale ga na qaravi ira na manumanu vuka.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Na vanua o Norway ena kune kina na veibaba se ulunivanua cere e vakadodonu sobu kei na veitokaitua sukusukura.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Na veitokaitua e dau kila tale ga me “vidde” kena ibalebale raba, e vanua bucabuca balavu qai galala.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Ena vanua o Rogaland kei Agder e dau kacivi tu me “hei” kena ibalebale vanua bucabuca e sega kina na vuniwai qai kena isalusalu na senikau totoka na heather.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: E sega ni toka dei na waicevata, ra qai teteva sobu na ulunivanua. Ena vakavuna na kakaca, qakilo, ena rairai sega ni laurai ena ikawakawa e ubia na ucacevata.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Na lalaga kei na delana ena qaravatu e solega na waicevata e rawa ni kasura qai tasogo eso na vanua e cicila toka.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ena batibatini waicevata lelevu e rawa ni dau kaca na tikini ucacevata se lutu, se tatiki qai qiqi yani.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: E levu na saravanua ra dau mai sarasara donuya na vulaikatakata ena veidelana.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ena yasana adua, donuya na vulaibatabata e duatani na ka era dau goleva, e levu na veidelana qori sara na solega tu na ucacevata qai caka kina eso na ka me vaka na vakatasisisi ena waicevata.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: E vica ga na waqavuka era vakarautaka na ivodovodo ni lai tikovi e dua na somate, e vakalutumi kina na ivodovodo ni lako ena dua na somate e tuvanaki vakasauri.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Na waqavuka era cakava qo o Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa vei ira na waqavuka e lako mai Merika se Kenada, kei na WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ia ena vinakati mo na qirita sara ga na kabani ni waqavuka mo sauma kina nomu tikite.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
